articles.title: Latent Lattice Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.
articles.titleCn: 潜在格律语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型通常通过更深的或循环的层以及潜在推理步骤来增加每个token的计算量，而更丰富的残差连接则改善了层间信息流。我们则通过增加计算能力：模型维持的活跃计算状态数量来提升性能。我们引入了“潜在格”（Lattice of Latents），这是一组每层水平的潜在流，它们沿着时间循环运行，同时伴随着垂直残差流穿过深度。像超连接（mHC）、注意力或值残差一样，潜在格增强了残差流，但它不是通过在深度中添加或重定向残差路径，而是提供跨token持续存在的伴随计算状态。与混合Transformer-SSM架构不同，其循环状态主要作为序列混合的内部记忆，这些潜在状态直接调节垂直流的注意力、KV缓存写入、MLP计算和解码。在训练了200亿FineWeb-Edu token的Transformer上，一个4.06亿参数的潜在格模型将验证集困惑度从15.41降低到14.40，超过了参数匹配的Transformer。这些收益扩展到不同的架构变体。潜在格与先前的残差流增强技术兼容：与超连接和输入残差结合时，它将验证集困惑度从15.41（基础Transformer）和14.22（具有相同增强的Transformer）降低到13.61。在Gated DeltaNet、Mamba-2、Triadic GDN和GDN-Mamba-2混合模型中，它在每个测试的原生状态大小上提高了困惑度，其中Lattice-GDN和Lattice-Triadic-GDN变体在原生状态大小是纯基线4倍的情况下表现更优。这些结果表明，持久每层状态是扩展语言模型计算能力的补充维度。

articles.title: Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction
articles.abstract: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters' discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.
articles.titleCn: 量化人类预报员讨论对热带气旋强度预测的增值
articles.abstractCn: 国家飓风中心会定期发布热带气旋讨论，为热带气旋预报提供参考。本研究探讨了这些讨论在强度预报方面超越数值预测器的附加价值。针对2002-2023年大西洋和东太平洋的637个热带气旋，我们分析了讨论文本及其与SHIPS和ERA5 10米风场提供的13个飓风环境预测器的结合，使用三种建模方法，对24至120小时的强度变化进行预报。其中一种方法采用文本端到端深度学习框架，结果显示讨论本身在24小时强度预报中与SHIPS预测器具有相当的价值。将讨论信息添加到五个此类模型的集成中，可降低2022-2023年飓风24小时最大持续风速预报的平均绝对误差，从9.89节降至8.90节，且当完整飓风重新采样时，置信区间不包含零。ERA5风场对风速预测的平均绝对误差影响较小，不同预测变量、提前时间和模型类型下模型排名存在差异。我们为这些预报提供了预测区间，但在快速增强期间，覆盖率低于90%的目标。文本分析显示，与强度和强度变化相关的词汇（如增强、减弱、眼壁和等级）对模型预测至关重要。这项回顾性研究显示了预报员讨论的附加价值，并表明多模态学习有助于理解专家人类判断的预测贡献。再分析数据与实时分析存在差异，且讨论发布时间至少晚于其他输入的有效时间三个小时，因此这些结果不应用于实际操作。

articles.title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
articles.abstract: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/
articles.titleCn: VLMs如何规划下一步
articles.abstractCn: 当一个视觉语言模型描述图像时，它会逐个命名对象，且很少重复，然而模型规划这一顺序的方式远非显而易见。我们分析了该模型在注视图像之前决定注视位置的机制。该机制包含四个主要部分。首先，绑定头将相关的文本标记与图像进行匹配，并将其解析为指向匹配图像区域的指针。其次，相同的绑定头将每个书面答案与其来源区域进行绑定，模型将其转化为进度信号：一个光标，即列表已写入的图像位置。第三，选择步骤在光标之后选择最近的未写入区域，或停止。最后，注视头执行所选指针，并返回该位置所绘概念，语言头和晚期MLPs将其转化为问题的语言中的词语。我们通过在合成视觉检索任务上对Qwen3-VL模型进行因果打补丁，验证了该机制每个部分的有效性，并针对替代假设进行了测试。我们进一步表明，该机制适用于不同输入格式、自然照片和语言，且其绑定头、中继头和注视头在从2B到32B的每个模型尺寸中都出现。这项工作使我们能够研究VLM如何逐层逐词地将问题与图像转化为答案序列。更广泛地说，它为研究模型如何规划复杂的多步任务打开了道路。我们的项目可在https://plan.baulab.info/获取。

articles.title: Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering
articles.abstract: Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026. We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies. Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.
articles.titleCn: 超越职位名称：使用稀疏自动编码器和语义聚类解读早期职业招聘广告
articles.abstractCn: 仅凭职位名称和职位描述无法充分了解技术岗位在变化就业市场中的差异。为评估此类岗位在工作和行业应用中的差异，我们基于深度学习和Transformer表示，设计并比较了两种方法，使用了从2025年12月至2026年10月在美国领英上收集的36,081份早期职业招聘信息。我们首先应用PERC方法，即预处理（P）、嵌入（E）、降维（R）和聚类（C）。我们采用GPT-6 Luna将职位描述段落分类为团队环境、角色任务和资质要求。随后，我们创建这些部分的组合，并检验是否通过嵌入和聚类分割段落能产生关于不同岗位的语义集群。我们使用最大平均差异（MMD）对嵌入分布的观测差异进行排序，并采用预训练的稀疏自动编码器（SAE）从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的第19层表示中提取特征。最后，我们使用GPT-6 Luna提出关于岗位特征模式的假设，并使用GPT-6.1 Terra调查这些模式是否存在于来自未见过公司的职位描述中。部分研究发现包括：数据科学家广告更强调机器学习模型开发，数据分析师广告侧重于报告业务绩效，机器学习工程师广告则关注将开发模型应用于实际场景。此外，我们观察到数据分析师与业务分析师广告在选定月份描述的应用存在差异，尽管数据集的规模和覆盖不均限制了其解读。总体而言，我们展示了SAE和PERC在非结构化文本数据中的实际应用，并探讨了自动化洞察提取如何支持职位描述的手动分析。

articles.title: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.
articles.titleCn: 阅读还是记忆？测量语言模型中的时间污染
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型现在被用于阅读央行文本进行经济预测，但大多数模型是在它们所读取的文档之后撰写的文本上训练的。一个读取2021年FOMC声明的模型可能已经知道2022年通胀上升，因此其表现出的部分能力可能是对结果的记忆，这是一种时间形式的数据集污染。我们通过比较现代开放模型与按时间顺序一致的模型（后者仅在固定日期之前的文本上训练）来测量FOMC声明和会议记录（2000年至2026年）上的这种记忆能力。在仅给出日期的情况下，无法知道答案的模型仍能从日期和时代的先验信息中获得高达0.64的AUC，因此随机性不是正确的基线。与这些无记忆模型在相同问题上的表现相比，大多数现代模型能够回忆起哪些年份经济增长强劲。成员推理分数会根据时代和文档类型对文档进行排序，而不是根据模型是否见过它们，因为开放预训练语料库中的确切计数显示。在实时预测中，我们估计的每项美国GDP的预期收益都小于宏观经济样本量下预测比较可以检测到的差异，并且GDP或通胀的预期收益在多重检验校正后均未通过检验。因此，预期收益审计应直接测量记忆，并与相同项目上的无记忆模型进行比较。

articles.title: Right Reason, Wrong Advice: Evaluating Recourse in LLM Explanations of Denied Requests
articles.abstract: Language models increasingly write the explanations people receive when a rule system denies their request. If several rules deny the request independently, an explanation can name a true reason and still leave the person denied after they fix it. We call the missing property recourse validity: changing what the explanation cites, without changing what was asked for, can flip the decision. We compute it exactly, and a hitting-set argument predicts from the policy alone when a correct reason fails. In six of seven rule systems ported from access control and US benefit eligibility, a single correct reason almost never gives recourse when several reasons apply. Across 20 LLMs, checks of whether the cited reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, are close to chance at spotting this failure, as the argument predicts. A strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work does spot it. Stronger and reasoning models do better but still fail on many denials with four or more independent reasons. Asking for every rule helps every open model with room to improve. Explanations of eligibility decisions should be built from the decision function and judged by whether acting on them works.
articles.titleCn: 正确理由，错误建议：评估被拒绝请求的LLM解释中的救济措施
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地撰写当规则系统拒绝请求时人们收到的解释。如果多个规则独立地拒绝请求，解释可以指出一个真实的原因，但在被拒绝者修正该原因后仍然会留下被拒绝的情况。我们称这种缺失属性为补救有效性：在不改变所请求内容的情况下，改变解释所引用的内容可以反转决策。我们精确地计算了它，并且一个撞击集论证仅从策略中预测了当正确原因失败时的情况。在从访问控制和美国家庭福利资格移植的七个规则系统中，当多个原因适用时，单一的正确原因几乎从不提供补救。在20个大型语言模型中，检查所引用的原因是否正确、是否由大型语言模型法官计算或询问，在发现这种失败方面接近于随机猜测，正如论证所预测的那样。一个被要求判断根据解释采取行动是否有效的强大法官能够发现它。更强的推理模型表现更好，但在有四个或更多独立原因的许多拒绝情况下仍然失败。要求每个规则都有帮助，为所有开放模型提供了改进的空间。资格决定的解释应基于决策函数构建，并通过判断根据它们采取行动是否有效来评估。

articles.title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.
articles.titleCn: 只言片语：定位与修复视觉语言模型中的跨图像比较
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在跨图像匹配点或物体时常常失败，即使答案可以从其隐藏状态中解码出来。我们在合成形状匹配、相同实例点对应（HPatches）和语义对应（SPair-71k）任务上，对Qwen3-VL（2B-32B）、InternVL3.5-8B和Gemma-3-12B模型进行了追踪，发现存在两个不同的失败点：一小部分负责比较的注意力头，以及一个仅影响0.02%参数的修复方法。两个失败点：精确副本被比较但未被读取。对于可命名和不可命名的形状，答案位置探针得分超出校准输出15至25分，沿探针方向移动的答案数量与随机方向无异。语义对应存在于视觉标记中，但从未到达答案。一条路径：重新分配16-32头的跨图像注意力，同时保持其质量，可降低合成任务17-22分和HPatches任务15-32分的准确率，而随机或注意力匹配头的最大降幅仅为7分。训练自动发现的杠杆：仅训练这些头的查询和键投影，可将SPair-71k准确率提高28.3分（Qwen3-VL-8B）和25.1分（InternVL3.5-8B），超越层匹配和注意力匹配头，并迁移至HPatches和BLINK。无约束的全层适配器通过相同头的注意力传递了21-51%的增益，而随机头的最大增幅仅为7%，这是通过改变它们读取的内容（效果占83-86%）而非权重实现的。每个决策规则在运行前均被冻结，所有报告的数字均由独立验证脚本重新计算。

articles.title: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching, noise dilutes, and ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of the verifier, its selection error and gap sign, together with a short saturation pilot, anticipates which phenotype a run will produce. Across nine configurations spanning two frameworks, two model vendors, two adapter sizes, three precisions, two initialisations and two seeds, the phenotypes recur, sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7, and optimistic gaps remain the steeper branch. The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. We release the testbed, the training instrumentation, and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) ported to executable oracles.

articles.titleCn: 乐观验证者被黑：在精确过程预言机下的奖励攻击
articles.abstractCn: 从可验证奖励中进行的强化学习继承了其验证器所犯的所有错误。在数学和代码之外，验证器是一个代理、一个标准、一个学习型裁判或一个手写检查器，它从未测量过与真实目标的距离，因此无法区分增长的奖励和黑客行为。我们构建了一个真实奖励在过程层面可精确计算的设置：在124,416个上下文中可执行的授权策略允许一个预言机列出每个决策的每个最小充分理由。我们将这些策略编译成精确的过程奖励，沿七个现实轴（仅结果、充分性、仅召回、提取噪声、粗略分类、过时策略、LLM裁判）降级验证器，并在精确验证器对每个展开进行评分的同时针对每个进行训练。出现了四种表型。乐观的验证器被填充攻击所破解：充分性代理在0.940处结束，而真实忠诚度在96个保留样本上从0.731降至0.667。仅结果验证器饱和并停止教学，噪声被稀释，保持排名差距无害。对验证器的无模型审计、其选择误差和差距符号，加上短暂的饱和试点，可以预测运行将产生哪种表型。跨越两个框架、两个模型供应商、两个适配器大小、三种精度、两种初始值和两种种子的九种配置中，表型重现，所有10个复制单元中充分性损害为正，在7个中超出两个标准误差，乐观差距仍然是更陡峭的分枝。损害幅度无法复制，报告了五个预先注册的尝试来解释它，因为它们失败了。我们发布了测试平台、训练仪器和14个真实公共策略（Cedar、OPA、Gatekeeper）移植到可执行预言机。

articles.title: Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.

articles.titleCn: 评估西班牙政治话语中大型语言模型的跨文化推理能力和鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于解读、生成和调解面向公众的语言，这使得它们在政治敏感环境中的可靠性尤为重要。尽管情感分析是这一领域的常见任务，但社交媒体话语中的情感意义往往通过文化特定且策略间接的线索来传达，而这些线索难以仅通过以标签为中心的评估来充分捕捉。在本文中，我们评估了LLMs在社交媒体西班牙语政治话语情感分析中的鲁棒性，特别关注文化特定的情感解读。我们引入了一种诊断协议，将三个独立的人类标注视图整合为“黄金”和“模糊”子集，并通过模型条件下的困惑度和LLM作为评判者的标准，从情感反转的假设情境中扩展语料库，构建了“合成”子集。利用这一框架，我们在零样本和少样本提示下比较了专有和开放权重模型，重点关注在人类共识条件和假设情境转换下的预测鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，标注模糊性和假设情境扰动揭示了传统原始语料库评估容易掩盖的失效模式。在评估的模型中，GPT-4.1-mini仍然最为稳定，而两个较小的开放权重模型在合成扰动下性能退化更为显著，少样本提示仅提供了有限的提升。总体而言，本文贡献了一种面向政治情感分析的鲁棒性评估可复现协议，对模型在模糊性和情感反转假设情境下的行为进行了实证描述，并提供了一个具有三方人类情感标注的公开可用西班牙语社交媒体数据集。

articles.title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
articles.abstract: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.
articles.titleCn: 无判断的程序：精确验证器下小语言模型所学习的内容
articles.abstractCn: 当授权策略阻止代理的工具调用时，审计日志应仅记录导致该决策的事实，不得包含其他信息。对于可执行策略在可枚举的上下文空间中，这种最小充分理由可以被精确计算，因此解释的评分依据真实情况而非其替代品。我们利用这种精确性来探究一个无误差的验证器能向模型学习什么。解释器仅看到一个请求和一个决策，从未见过策略本身，并且有三十轮机会在修改后的请求上调用策略，询问候选事实集是否充分。前沿模型仅使用工具就能找到精确理由的概率约为一半，而一句指示其缩减答案的指令将Haiku 4.5的准确率从58%提升至75%。一个在2000个删除算法跟踪记录上微调的4B模型，在训练策略上达到了92%的准确率。教师类型是关键因素：在匹配的数据规模下，算法指导的学生在所有三个训练种子中都领先于前沿指导的学生，且两者的表现从未重叠。学生学习的固定是充分性检查的调度表，而该调度表不会迁移。在三个从未见过的新公共策略上，其答案依然保持充分性（94%），但不再是最小化（48%），而Haiku在相同指令下在所有47个案例中都保持精确。从精确奖励中学习的强化学习将保留准确率维持在原位，并逆转策略，从探测策略到将全部预算用于充分性检查。神谕使训练效果变得可见，但它并未让训练变得更好。

articles.title: Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization
articles.abstract: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings is a standard measure of whether online discourse is converging under generative AI. When the embeddings are mean-pooled outputs of an encoder never trained for sentence similarity, this measure mostly tracks text length. In 6.06 million Reddit comments, an uncentered DeBERTa-v3 measure had suggested that only conservative discourse broke toward homogeneity after late 2022. Truncating the same comments from 10 to 150 words raises their mean cosine by eight times the reported break. A placebo that swaps every comment for a random one of equal length reproduces 81% of the asymmetry, and a fixed-content simulation reproduces 78%. The leading principal direction carries 99.9% of raw DeBERTa homogeneity, and once length is handled the asymmetry disappears under every encoder. On 575,000 Stack Exchange answers the measure reports a post-ChatGPT homogenization of technical sites that the placebo fully reproduces, although answers grew longer. A census of 31 studies locates the risk where anisotropic encoders meet time-series or length-unequal designs. A reverse control on a well-known experiment shows that centering with renormalization can reverse a genuine effect. I propose a low-cost diagnostic protocol. Corrected measures show that the two political camps converged between 2019 and 2022 and stopped converging before ChatGPT. Cross-camp replies engage their targets more closely than same-camp replies.

articles.titleCn: 嵌入余弦度量在衡量同质化之前先衡量文本长度
articles.abstractCn: Transformer嵌入之间的平均成对余弦相似度是衡量生成式AI下在线讨论是否趋同的标准指标。当嵌入是未经句子相似度训练的编码器的平均池化输出时，该指标主要反映文本长度。在606万Reddit评论中，未居中的DeBERTa-v3指标显示，仅在2022年后保守派讨论趋向同质化。将相同评论从10词截断到150词，使其平均余弦值提高了报告断裂点的八倍。一个将每条评论替换为等长随机评论的安慰剂实验复制了81%的对称性，而固定内容模拟复制了78%。主导主方向承载了99.9%的原始DeBERTa同质性，一旦处理长度，所有编码器下的对称性消失。在57.5万Stack Exchange答案中，该指标报告了ChatGPT后技术网站的同质化，安慰剂实验完全复制了这一现象，尽管答案变长了。对31项研究的普查定位了各向异性编码器与时间序列或长度不等设计相遇的风险。对一项著名实验的逆向控制显示，居中与再归一化可以逆转真实效应。我提出了一种低成本诊断方案。校正后的指标显示，两派政治阵营在2019年至2022年间趋同，并在ChatGPT出现前停止了趋同。跨派回复比同派回复更紧密地针对目标。

articles.title: Detection-Efficient Watermarking for Vision--Language Agents via Risk-Constrained Strength Allocation
articles.abstract: Vision--language agents generate descriptions, decisions, and instructions that may be reused by users, downstream agents, and automated workflows, creating a need for provenance mechanisms that support content authenticity and post-deployment auditing without unnecessarily degrading response quality. We present a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that combines predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy to allocate watermark strength during decoding. A single risk penalty $λ$ exposes a continuous operating frontier, allowing deployment-time selection of a detection--quality trade-off without model retraining. At a selected operating point, mean watermark strength is reduced by approximately 59.4\% relative to fixed-strength watermarking, while perplexity change falls from 0.3634 to 0.1689 and clean/paraphrased ROC-AUC reaches 0.9552/0.9459. A matched-strength analysis shows that this advantage reflects the allocation policy rather than lower average intervention: at comparable mean strength, risk-constrained allocation achieves substantially higher ROC-AUC than fixed, entropy-only, and criticality-only policies, identifying it as detection-efficient rather than quality-dominant. We further show that threshold calibration on finite samples produces substantial false-positive-rate drift, motivating calibration variance reporting as standard practice for auditable provenance.
articles.titleCn: 面向视觉-语言代理的风险约束强度分配的检测高效水印技术
articles.abstractCn: 愿景——语言智能体生成可供用户、下游智能体和自动化工作流复用的描述、决策和指令，这催生了对可追溯性机制的需求，该机制需支持内容真实性和部署后审计，同时不必要地降低响应质量。我们提出了一种风险感知语义水印框架，该框架结合预测不确定性与零样本多模态相关性风险代理，在解码过程中分配水印强度。单一风险惩罚λ暴露出连续运行边界，允许在部署时选择检测质量权衡，无需模型再训练。在选定运行点，平均水印强度相较于固定强度水印降低了约59.4%，困惑度变化从0.3634降至0.1689，干净/释义ROC-AUC分别达到0.9552/0.9459。匹配强度分析表明，这一优势反映的是分配策略而非较低的平均干预：在可比平均强度下，风险约束分配比固定、仅熵和仅关键性策略实现显著更高的ROC-AUC，证明其为检测高效而非质量主导。我们进一步表明，在有限样本上的阈值校准会导致显著的假阳性率漂移，因此将校准方差报告作为可审计可追溯的标准实践。

articles.title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
articles.abstract: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.

articles.titleCn: Jetriever：将代理记忆检索从相似性转向效用
articles.abstractCn: 一个有用的记忆不必与它帮助回答的问题相似。Jetriever根据Jev对当前问题有用性的决策分数对每个存储的记忆进行排序，用全池效用评分取代了相似性搜索。在InMind的125个间接查询任务中，它在84.8%的情况下将黄金交换排在首位；匹配的BM25和MiniLM控制组在索引用户转换时分别达到1.6%和0.0%。一个包含20个问题的比较将发现证据与对其进行排序区分开来：Jev和Qwen3.5 9B各在前50名中找到90%的黄金交换，而Laya找到30%；在第一名的排名中，Jev达到85%，Qwen3.5 9B达到40%。在一个维度成比例的随机样本的60个MemoryAgentBench问题中，Jetriever的四维分数为55.4%，而ReFind在相同问题上的分数为44.3%。Jev检索平均每InMind问题成本0.00834美元，每MAB问题成本0.03103美元。这些结果表明了世界知识的价值、排名决定性记忆的分数以及可负担的全池评分。

articles.title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
articles.abstract: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.
articles.titleCn: 平衡双权重分解用于高效的多语言大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 权重分解（WF）方法旨在降低模型的延迟、内存占用或两者兼有。这些方法通常将预训练模型分解为两个或多个因子，通过更少的参数和浮点运算（FLOPs）来近似原始模型权重。然而，在实践中，将更少的FLOPs转化为降低延迟对WF方法来说是一个挑战，因为用多个较小的权重矩阵替换单个大型权重矩阵会引入额外的开销。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了平衡双权重分解（BTWF），它利用分解模型的独特结构，同时降低延迟并提升学习能力。具体而言，BTWF在共享基权重分解（shared basis WF）设置中运行，其中两个或多个层被分解为一个共享基矩阵和一个特定层的混合矩阵。如果这些共享层具有相同的输入（即它们是双胞胎层），那么我们只需要执行一次共享前向传递，从而减少推理时间。然而，双胞胎层的大小往往不同，以往的方法倾向于优先考虑较大的层。相比之下，我们的方法通过结合权重分量平衡（FCB），确保每个共享成员在选定的因子中都有良好表示，以及块贡献平衡（BCB），考虑下游模型的影响，从而提升性能。此外，我们还表明，在训练过程中某些层的因子导致更高的FLOPs的超参数化BTWF，可以在测试时无需额外资源的情况下提升任务性能。在九个基准测试上的六个模型上的实验表明，BTWF在不进行昂贵的微调（微调时增益为1-3.5%）的情况下，以相当的计算成本获得了比现有最佳技术高2-6%的增益。

articles.title: A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
articles.abstract: Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.
articles.titleCn: 一个用于建模标注任务中人口统计分歧的可扩展多任务学习框架
articles.abstractCn: 来自不同社会背景的标注者往往由于不同的生活经历、文化背景以及他们与内容的关系，在系统性的方式上产生分歧。当出现这种分歧时，某一群体的观点有时需要优先考虑，因为他们拥有知识论上的优势立场，或者对结果承担更大的责任。例如，在评估社交媒体上帖子的毒性时，优先考虑目标群体的观点可能很重要。我们提出了一种利益相关者感知联合多任务学习（SAJ-MTL）框架，以联合建模标注者群体间和群体内的社会背景分歧。该模型使用条件梯度路由来处理由群体条件标签引起的稀疏性问题，参数化支持在不同任务设置中对群体进行定制化加权。SAJ-MTL通过更好地理解与社会背景敏感内容相关的上下文信息，提高了毒性检测中的群体级性能。仅需标注者群体成员信息，这比需要更多侵犯隐私的个人级标注者详细信息的方法更具实用性。我们的可扩展架构在计算上也高效，支持大规模部署。

articles.title: Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers
articles.abstract: Researchers at MIT recently reported that GPT-6 Astra, a frontier large language model (LLM), can write the weights of small neural networks directly in a single reply, and can read the raw weights of small networks to say what they were trained to do. In a three-day sprint, we replicated and extended these results. Our four findings: (1) Writing weights reproduces. Astra's networks for the game Breakout scored 514, 550 and 307 (versus MIT's 517), and scored just as well on two modified versions of Breakout. Claude Opus 5.5 can also write working networks, but often runs out of output tokens. (2) What is new is translating programs into weights. Earlier models could write a good policy as code a generation before they could write network weights, and the networks the models write behave like compiled programs: two models independently decompiled Astra's Breakout network into Python matching its actions in all tested states. On classifying handwritten digits, Astra's networks scored 50% on average, below a simple classifier (82%). (3) Reading weights is mostly reading the input layer. Astra and Opus 5.5 identify which game a network plays almost perfectly, but on three new games we designed and trained ourselves, Astra recovered where things are on the board, while mostly missing how the game works. (4) Auditing from weights alone is possible but shallow. Without executing code, Astra picked out a small language model poisoned during training in 10 of 10 runs, one poisoned by extra training afterwards in 7 of 10, and a malicious adapter in 23 of 32 cases, but never identified the trigger or malicious behaviour. Open-weight models lag behind. From this early study, we conclude that LLMs can read and write small networks, but that this currently amounts to compiling hand-designed programs and reading the layout of the input layer. It is a promising but early tool for interpretability.
articles.titleCn: 复制和扩展权重空间编程：前沿大型语言模型将程序编译成权重并读取输入层
articles.abstractCn: 麻省理工学院的研究人员最近报告称，前沿大型语言模型（LLM）GPT-6 Astra可以直接在单次回复中写出小神经网络的权重，并能读取小网络的原始权重以说明它们被训练用于做什么。在为期三天的冲刺中，我们复现并扩展了这些结果。我们的四个发现：（1）写权重可以复现。Astra用于Breakout游戏的网络得分分别为514、550和307（对比麻省理工学院的517），在两个修改版的Breakout游戏中表现同样出色。Claude Opus 5.5也能写出可工作的网络，但经常输出token耗尽。（2）新的是将程序翻译成权重。早期模型在能写出网络权重之前，需要先写出一段好的策略代码，而模型写出的网络表现得像编译好的程序：两个模型独立地反编译了Astra的Breakout网络，得到了在所有测试状态下与其行为匹配的Python代码。在手写数字分类任务中，Astra的网络平均得分50%，低于简单的分类器（82%）。（3）读权重主要是读输入层。Astra和Opus 5.5几乎完美地识别出网络所玩的游戏，但在我们设计和训练的三款新游戏中，Astra能恢复棋盘上的位置，却大多无法理解游戏规则。（4）仅凭权重进行审计是可能的，但深度有限。在不执行代码的情况下，Astra在10次运行中识别出在训练中中毒的小语言模型，在7次运行中识别出训练后中毒的模型，在32次中的23次识别出恶意适配器，但从未识别出触发器或恶意行为。开放权重模型落后。从这项早期研究来看，我们得出结论，LLM可以读写小网络，但目前这相当于编译手设计的程序和读取输入层的布局。这是一个有前景但尚处早期的可解释性工具。

articles.title: Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits
articles.abstract: Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [-2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval [-2.0, +0.8], and -0.8 points, interval [-2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solve the LP, but the neurons it shares with the LP solution carry most of its mean push. The outcome is that, on this model, the edit acts as a nearly constant bias along u.
articles.comment: 4 pages, 3 tables. Data, code and protocols: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24286137
articles.titleCn: 直接搞定！关于秩一反回路编辑背后的线性规划笔记
articles.abstractCn: 权重空间编程通过一个MLP输出矩阵的秩一编辑W' = W + u v^T来移除小型推理模型的思考循环，其中u是循环方向，v是关于神经元激活的稀疏线性规划（LP）的解。我们研究了是否需要LP。我们将其替换为排序：我们选取激活系数变异最小的8个神经元，并将LP解实现的推动力平均分配给它们。在Qwen3.5-0.8B上，排序编辑在1000个问题（MATH-500和GSM8K）上的得分为67.0%，而LP编辑得分为67.4%，未编辑模型得分为9.5%；配对差异为-0.4分，95%置信区间为[-2.9, +2.1]，在运行前声明的非劣性边际为5分内。在另外三个采样种子上，当不使用LP时，差异分别为-0.6分，区间[-2.0, +0.8]，和-0.8分，区间[-2.3, +0.6]。排序并未解决LP，但它与LP解共享的神经元承载了其大部分平均推动力。结果是，在这个模型上，编辑相当于沿u方向的一个近似恒定偏差。

articles.title: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
articles.abstract: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.
articles.titleCn: 基于评分标准的AES与LLM集成：利用LLM集成对关键在线推理中的学生回答进行评分
articles.abstractCn: 对学生的回答进行评分既昂贵又耗时。此外，人工标注者容易受到偏见、疲劳和评分者漂移的影响，这进一步限制了评分的可靠性。为了降低这些成本并解决与偏见相关的问题，人们已经采用了各种方法来开发自动作文评分（AES）系统。这些方法从早期的基于文本特征的系统到当前的机器学习和基于转换器的模型不等。具体而言，大型语言模型（LLM）为简化AES系统的开发提供了潜力。然而，它们受到众所周知的限制，例如幻觉和提示敏感性。这促使人们探索混合方法的可能性，通过集成形成来利用单个LLM之间的协同效应。我们评估了LLM集成在经济学和医学教育中对学生回答进行评分时与人类评分者一致性的潜力，涉及103个标准。我们使用了631份德语文本回答以及之前进行评估时由2到5名标注者提供的相应评分。我们测试了15个开放权重LLM的523种基于评分标准的提示配置，并使用Krippendorff's alpha（用于标注者间一致性）和替代标注者测试（alt-test）评估其与人类评分者的一致性。我们的结果表明，用表现最佳的LLM-提示配置替换一名人类评分者，在103个标准中的91个上保持了或提高了标注者间一致性，并且LLM在90个标准上通过了替代标注者测试。我们的研究结果表明，当前最先进的LLM可以支持经济学和医学教育中德语文本回答的AES，从而减轻人工工作量并实现更快的处理，但与人类评分者的验证仍然是必要的。

articles.title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
articles.abstract: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% $\to$ 82.7% and 14.3% $\to$ 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% $\to$ 90.5% and 21.9% $\to$ 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org
articles.titleCn: AuXSpec：通过可执行后置条件自动形式化程序规范的学习
articles.abstractCn: 形式化规范定义了预期程序行为并支撑验证，但在定理证明器（如Lean）中编写它们既缓慢又需要专业知识，使得规范成为扩展形式正确代码的主要瓶颈。从自然语言问题中自动形式化具有前景，但训练规范模型需要可扩展的反馈来判断生成的规范是否捕获了预期行为。先前方法通过显式证明或单独实现的与形式对应证明的代码来获取这种反馈，两者都代价高昂。我们引入了AuXSpec，这是一个Lean框架，它将声明性后置条件与可执行对应物配对，通过类型类解析（在可能的情况下）或通过等价证明单独定义。然后，测试用例可以通过执行来评估声明性规范，让我们使用一致性作为强化学习的奖励。使用AuXSpec，我们合成了3,037个LeetCode问题，并通过在Codeforces上的专家迭代将训练扩展到19.5K个样本。实验表明，使用基于执行的奖励训练Qwen3.5-9B和Qwen3.8-27B，提高了AuXSpec-Test的SpecGen pass@4，从0.7%提升到82.7%，从14.3%提升到84.3%，27B模型优于所有前沿模型。在域外Verina基准及其原始提示上，两个模型分别从7.0%提升到90.5%和21.9%提升到90.5%，并在pass@1（它们的47.6% vs. 我们的73.7%和84.5%）和pass@4（它们的63.9%在pass@10 vs. 我们的90.5%）上超越了VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B，后者是开源规范模型中的当前最先进技术。我们发布了训练的9B和27B模型的权重以及3,037个包含测试用例的问题，包括300个问题的AuXSpec-Test基准，该基准经过专家审查和正确性证明，供未来评估。模型和数据：https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec。网站：https://auxspec.org

articles.title: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
articles.abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.
articles.comment: 48 pages, 5 figures. Code, data pointers and pre-registrations: https://github.com/JaviMaligno/latent-gap-ideas
articles.titleCn: 嵌入映射距离是否指导了大型语言模型的构思？针对“接下来会发生什么”的四项测试
articles.abstractCn: 一种流行的创意构思方法将现有工作的嵌入映射视为指南：选择远离一切的点并将其解码为创意。我测试了四种这种距离如何指导创意构思，并与后来出现的内容进行了对比。(1) 远离所有方向的随机点不是文本：没有后来的项目能达到原始余弦值高于0.10，即使经过中心化或白化处理，24个单元格中有22个无法触及；向大型语言模型解码器展示目标邻居，仅提供得分反馈，会在所有六个目标集中写入这些邻居。无邻居搜索在中间间隙处写出连贯文本，中位数余弦值为0.57和0.47，在20个中的15个和14个上优于最近现有项目，但在远点处仅为0.07和0.06。(2) 在仅过去的k-means单元格映射中，注册的空洞分数主要跟踪单元格大小和位置；三种基于密度的间隙分数预测哪些单元格增长最快且低于随机水平（AUC为0.30至0.66），但它们对Steam和arXiv的势头没有贡献，专利结果不明确；更孤立的新Steam游戏评价略好。(3) 大型语言模型对arXiv论文的续写比引用该论文的论文更接近源论文，在三种用户提示下，与提案重写（gpt-4o）和2023年4月至12月的论文（OLMo）对比。批评延长了这一步骤，超越了无内容的修订，并在150篇新论文上得到验证。揭示真实续作的标题会使创意沿续作特定方向旋转0.032，审稿人、神谕和距离反馈分别增加了0.13、0.08和0.34的旋转（上限为0.46、0.46、0.70），而它们的旋转与修订或更长的步骤不可分离。(4) 对于按距离评级的灵感材料，未检测到倒U型关系，预期边际更多地跟踪格式而非内容。原始测试在运行前注册，续作（在两次AI代理评审中请求了十三项）在主要结果之后；所有内容仅通过本地git提交进行日期标注。

articles.title: Beyond Bilingual: Studying Quadrilingual Code-Switching with Conversational AI
articles.abstract: Multilingual speakers choose languages by topic and conversation partner. Large language models (LLMs) support these languages unequally. Research on code-switching with conversational AI has mostly examined bilingual pairs of well-resourced languages. In Curaçao and Aruba, many people use Dutch, English, Spanish, and the low-resource Creole Papiamentu/o. In a preregistered study, 42 university students held two five-minute chatbot conversations, one about university life and one about local food and culture. Surveys assessed language background, AI use, and switching comfort. 20 international students in Curaçao formed a comparison sample. Participants switched between turns and rarely mixed languages within a message. English dominated both conversations. Participants switched more often in the cultural conversation, where Papiamentu/o and Spanish rose from 15% to 24% of messages. Self-reports showed no lower comfort switching with the chatbot than with a person. Conversational agents must follow turn-by-turn language changes and handle local low-resource languages well.
articles.titleCn: 超越双语：运用对话式人工智能研究四语码转换
articles.abstractCn: 多语使用者会根据话题和对话伙伴选择语言。大型语言模型（LLM）对这些语言的支持并不均衡。关于与对话式人工智能进行代码转换的研究，大多考察了资源丰富的双语者。在库拉索和阿鲁巴，许多人使用荷兰语、英语、西班牙语以及资源较少的克里奥尔语Papiamentu/o。在一项预先注册的研究中，42名大学生进行了两次五分钟的聊天机器人对话，一次关于大学生活，一次关于当地食物和文化。调查问卷评估了语言背景、人工智能使用情况以及转换舒适度。库拉索的20名国际学生组成了比较样本。参与者在轮次之间切换语言，且很少在一条消息内混合语言。英语在两次对话中都占据主导地位。参与者在文化对话中切换频率更高，其中Papiamentu/o和西班牙语的比例从15%上升到24%。自我报告显示，与聊天机器人切换语言并不比与人切换语言感到更不舒适。对话式代理必须遵循逐轮的语言变化，并妥善处理当地的低资源语言。

articles.title: Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning a small typed decision model on one user's email labels did not clear the margin we pre-registered over a logistic regression trained on the same labels. In earlier work, about two hundred labels and a TF-IDF logistic regression had the highest point accuracy on this inbox, though not significantly above the best hosted model; we ask whether the same labels, given to a decision model, close the gap. A first registered study, on a generic 4B base with cross-validation and message type only, stayed below the baseline at every label budget (-1.8 to -7.3 points). The main study was registered before any fine-tuning run: a fixed test set of 135 emails never used for selection, LoRA adapters on the public Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B decision models, nested subsets of 50 to 587 labels, two seeds and five decision fields on a free T4 GPU. Four of its five hypotheses are refuted--two in the fine-tunes' favour--and one is confirmed for one model. On message type the 4B model misses the registered three-point margin at 400 labels (+2.6) and passes it with all 587 (+3.3); with all labels both models are above the baseline by +0.7 and +3.3 points, where one email is 0.74 points and a 95% interval is about 15 points wide, and the 4B model is clearly ahead in type macro-F1 (0.581 vs. 0.406). On the three action switches the baseline is ahead at every label budget for both models (0.931 vs. 0.904 and 0.899 mean accuracy with all labels), at under a millisecond per question against 306 and 1681 ms. The 0.8B type curve barely improves after 300 labels and then falls. The baseline never predicts the two rarest classes (7 offers and 8 spam in the training pool); the fine-tuned models find spam in some runs, not consistently across seeds. We list the explanations we did not test and say when a new attempt would be worth making. Scripts are public; weights and emails are not.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955. Pre-registered study; code at https://github.com/federicolucca/foyer-measure (tag v2.4; registrations in prereg/); weights and data not released
articles.titleCn: 在测量之后训练：针对在单个用户标签上微调类型化决策模型的一个预先注册的学习曲线
articles.abstractCn: 在单个用户的邮件标签上微调小型类型化决策模型并未消除我们预先注册的边际优势，该优势高于在相同标签上训练的逻辑回归模型。在早期工作中，大约两百个标签和TF-IDF逻辑回归在这个收件箱上实现了最高的点精度，尽管并未显著高于最佳托管模型；我们询问相同标签赋予决策模型是否能缩小差距。一项首次注册的研究，基于通用的4B基础模型，仅使用交叉验证和消息类型，在所有标签预算下（-1.8至-7.3分）均低于基线。主要研究在任何微调运行前注册：一个固定的135封邮件测试集从未用于选择，在公共的Tev1-0.8B和Tev1-4B决策模型上使用LoRA适配器，嵌套的50至587个标签子集，两个种子和五个决策字段，在免费的T4 GPU上运行。其中五个假设中有四个被反驳——两个有利于微调——一个被证实适用于一个模型。在消息类型上，4B模型在400个标签时（+2.6分）未能达到注册的三分优势，而在所有587个标签时（+3.3分）超过了该优势；在所有标签下，两个模型均高于基线+0.7分和+3.3分，其中一封邮件为0.74分，95%置信区间约为15分宽，且4B模型在类型宏观F1（0.581 vs. 0.406）上明显领先。在三个动作开关上，两个模型在所有标签预算下均落后于基线（所有标签的平均准确率分别为0.931、0.904和0.899），每题耗时不到一毫秒，而基线耗时306毫秒和1681毫秒。0.8B类型曲线在300个标签后几乎不再改善，随后开始下降。基线从未预测出两个最罕见的类别（训练集中有7个提议和8个垃圾邮件）；微调模型在某些运行中检测到垃圾邮件，但跨种子并不一致。我们列出了未测试的解释，并说明何时进行新的尝试会值得。脚本公开；权重和邮件不公开。

articles.title: Stability-Compensated Threshold Calibration for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models often produce hallucinated answers, motivating selective prediction policies that abstain on uncertain queries. However, heuristic uncertainty thresholds alone do not provide statistical control of errors among accepted predictions. Linear Expectation Constraints (LEC) reduce selection-conditioned error rate (SCER) calibration to a nonpositive expected linear-loss constraint, but the associated loss is non-monotonic in the acceptance threshold. We construct an exact counterexample under i.i.d. sampling demonstrating that LEC's empirical threshold-selection rule can violate the population SCER target. To address this risk-transfer gap, we introduce Stability-Compensated Linear Expectation Control (SC-LEC), which uses the negative linear risk of a theoretical full-data reference to compensate for threshold-selection instability. For local expansion beyond a safe anchor, we derive two finite-sample certificates: a stability-based certificate exploiting rank crossings and a direct certificate using the structure of threshold expansion to reduce conservatism. With a valid population anchor margin, our certificate conditions ensure finite-sample marginal SCER control, and independent margin certification further provides a $1-δ$ high-probability guarantee for this calibration-averaged control. Experiments on CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, and TriviaQA show useful retention gains beyond the same certified anchor, while revealing conservative behavior in small-margin regimes.
articles.titleCn: 针对大型语言模型的条件风险控制中的选择条件下的稳定性补偿阈值校准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型常常产生幻觉性答案，这促使了选择性预测策略的出现，即在不确定的查询中保持沉默。然而，仅依靠启发式的不确定性阈值并不能对接受的预测中的错误提供统计控制。线性期望约束（LEC）将选择条件错误率（SCER）校准简化为非正的期望线性损失约束，但相关的损失在接受阈值上是非单调的。我们在独立同分布（i.i.d.）抽样下构建了一个精确的反例，证明了LEC的经验阈值选择规则可能违反总体SCER目标。为了解决这种风险转移差距，我们引入了稳定性补偿线性期望控制（SC-LEC），它利用理论全数据参考的负线性风险来补偿阈值选择的不稳定性。为了在安全锚点之外进行局部扩展，我们推导出两个有限样本证书：一个基于稳定性的证书，利用秩交叉；另一个直接证书，利用阈值扩展的结构来减少保守性。在具有有效总体锚点余量下，我们的证书条件确保有限样本边际SCER控制，而独立的余量认证进一步为这种校准平均控制提供了$1-δ$的高概率保证。在CommonsenseQA、ARC-Challenge和TriviaQA上的实验显示了超越相同认证锚点的有用保留增益，同时揭示了在小余量区域中的保守行为。

articles.title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
articles.abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.
articles.titleCn: 由众包审计的、基于LLM驱动的代理的隐性偏见图谱
articles.abstractCn: 已有研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）在高曝光度、一次性决策场景（如招聘和智力评估）中表现出隐性偏见。然而，随着人们越来越多地使用自主的、由LLM驱动的AI代理来为他们日常任务中的决策代言，理解基于社会人口统计假设的隐性偏见如何在广泛的日常决策场景中产生，具有至关重要的意义。我们使用了美国时间使用调查（ATUS）中的17个日常活动领域，生成了包含506个决策场景的图谱，其中LLM——被赋予代表不同种族、性别认同和政治意识形态的角色——表现出显著的隐性偏见。随后，在众包审计中，500名参与者对哪些隐性偏见的决策场景最值得进一步审查做出了8,010个二元选择。我们发现，参与者优先考虑那些具有广泛相关性（例如关于食物选择）、高风险（例如关于健康）以及模拟社会人口统计群体中所有成员达成一致决策的场景（因为这明显是刻板印象的迹象）。他们受观察到的差异幅度或决策场景所代表的具体ATUS领域的影响较小。在考察他们优先选择背后的理由时，我们发现参与者通常将差异解释为人口群体的特征，并判断这些特征是否合理，这往往基于他们自身内化的刻板印象。我们讨论了构建个性化AI代理、数字孪生、社会模拟以及使用众包偏见审计的启示。

articles.title: What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
articles.abstract: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.
articles.titleCn: 你发布的内容就是你症状：从社交媒体话语中估计心理测量网络
articles.abstractCn: 精神病理学中的症状网络几乎完全基于自我报告问卷进行估计，这限制了推断范围仅限于特定测量工具所涵盖的症状集合。我们提出了一种直接从社交媒体讨论中估计症状解析网络的框架，并将该框架应用于抑郁症和饮食障碍，同时使用第三个厌食症语料库进行跨数据集验证。据我们所知，我们是首批从社交媒体文本中估计症状解析心理测量网络、将其与临床共认可网络进行比较，并在涵盖两种疾病的三个独立招募语料库中复制跨诊断语言标记的研究者。对于抑郁症，表达评分与BDI-II总分的相关系数为$ρ{=}0.434$，21项中的20项达到FDR显著性水平，分半信度为0.935。网络比较测试检测到模态间边差异较少（3-5%的边），但桥接症状存在差异。对于饮食障碍，项目级结果具有探索性。识别的语言特征在所有三个语料库中均重复相同方向，并聚类于三个结构家族。

articles.title: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
articles.abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
articles.titleCn: 藏文OCR的音节和单词级评估
articles.abstractCn: 藏文光学字符识别（OCR）主要采用字符错误率（CER）进行评估。藏文标记音节边界但不标记词边界，因此需要分词器来计算词错误率。本研究评估了九种识别器配置在排版、木刻和两种手写体风格上的性能，单独及组合使用，并报告了音节级和词级错误率，据我们所知这是首次对藏文OCR进行此类评估。这些配置涵盖了CTC模型、带和不带后训练量化的TrOCR编码器-解码器，以及一个视觉语言模型，每种配置均在CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词词错误率（SWER）下进行评分。CER的排名与高级别错误率（Kendall τ≥0.833）大体一致，仅有一对排名相反。在联合训练效果方面，CER和SER在64次比较中的7次记录了符号相反的显著变化。SER无需分词器，在三种分词器中的两种下（τ≥0.889）的排名与SWER一致。每种配置的输出还进行了词性标注、命名实体标注和机器翻译，并将每种结果与参考文本进行比较。作为粗略参考，当SER低于0.047或词性保留率低于0.8（0.078或更低）时，可达到约60的chrF翻译效果，而没有任何错误率能区分达到0.6实体保留率的系统与未达到该保留率的系统。

articles.title: Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words
articles.abstract: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.
articles.titleCn: 潜在桥梁：无言的求助
articles.abstractCn: 基于文本的模型协作需要一个大模型生成中间响应，然后小模型才能使用其指导，这给推理增加了大模型解码成本。我们引入了POND（仅预填充，无需解码）方法，该方法使用冻结的大发送器进行预填充，并使用小接收器进行所有自回归解码。一个可训练的桥梁将发送器的隐藏状态映射到额外的注意力键和值，允许接收器在整个生成过程中使用这些表示。POND还支持周期性审查，其中发送器处理接收器的部分响应，并通过额外的预填充过程更新其指导，同时保留接收器现有的KV缓存。在推理和编码基准测试中，POND使用来自不同模型系列的发送器提升了接收器的性能。特别是，当与Qwen接收器配对时，GLM-5.3提供的收益与Qwen3.8-Max相当，支持了独立训练模型系列之间表示迁移的有效性。POND进一步展示了其跨领域泛化的能力。当在数学和编码任务上训练时，它可以直接迁移到一般知识任务，无需额外的领域特定训练。这些结果表明，大前沿模型的预填充表示可以提升小模型的生成，而无需大模型的自回归解码。

articles.title: LATTE-WordSeg-Lite: Multi-Granularity Thai Word Segmentation on a CPU, with a Reproducible Benchmark
articles.abstract: Large language models read Thai through subword tokens, without a word segmenter. Yet Thai treebanks, speech metrics and morphological resources are built on words, often at several granularities, and word boundaries resolve ambiguities that subword tokens leave open. LATTE (Lattice ATTentive Encoding) reads a text at several granularities at once, through a lattice of dictionary words, but it is a large GPU model. We distil it into LATTE-WordSeg-Lite, a CPU segmenter of 1.17M parameters that keeps the lattice as features. It outputs compounds, words and morphemes in one pass, and learns only from annotated data and text whose licences allow commercial use. To compare it with other tools, published Thai scores do not suffice, as they come from different files, splits and scorers. We therefore rebuild seven test sets from pinned sources and score twelve systems under one protocol. With the unit that fits each test set, LATTE-WordSeg-Lite scores above DeepCut on five sets, four of them from corpora that its teachers learnt from. Called line by line on one CPU thread, it runs 23 times as fast as DeepCut. We release the model, the benchmark scripts and all predictions.
articles.titleCn: LATTE-WordSeg-Lite：在CPU上进行多粒度泰语词法分割，并具有可复现的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通过子词标记读取泰语，而无需词段器。然而，泰语树库、语音指标和形态资源都是基于单词构建的，通常具有多种粒度，并且词边界可以解决子词标记留下的歧义。LATTE（格子注意力编码）同时以多种粒度读取文本，通过字典单词的格子，但它是一个大型GPU模型。我们将它蒸馏成LATTE-WordSeg-Lite，一个包含1.17M参数的CPU段器，它将格子作为特征保留。它一次输出复合词、单词和词素，并且仅从带注释的数据和允许商业使用的文本中学习。为了与其他工具进行比较，已发表的泰语分数并不充分，因为它们来自不同的文件、分割和评分器。因此，我们从固定的来源重新构建了七个测试集，并在一个协议下对十二个系统进行评分。对于每个测试集，LATTE-WordSeg-Lite在五个集中得分高于DeepCut，其中四个集来自其教师学习过的语料库。在单个CPU线程上逐行调用时，它的运行速度比DeepCut快23倍。我们发布了模型、基准脚本和所有预测结果。

articles.title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.
articles.titleCn: AnachroBench：评估大型视觉语言模型中的历史一致性
articles.abstractCn: 现有的视觉-语言模型基准主要评估一般日常场景中的视觉理解能力，而针对特定时代和国家的历史一致性则探索不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AnachroBench，这是一个用于评估视觉场景历史一致性的受控判别基准。该基准包含来自八个国家的1600对图像，时间跨度从19世纪末到20世纪初，每对图像都包含一张原始历史图像和一张包含无缝插入的现代物体的错时版本。AnachroBench评估三个方面：插入物体感知，测试模型是否能检测到插入的现代物体；时代-国家一致性，评估场景是否与指定的时代和国家一致；以及条件性时代-国家一致性，仅当插入物体被正确感知时进行一致性判断。当模型感知到现代物体但仍将场景判断为历史一致时，会发生错误的一致性判断。总体而言，AnachroBench揭示了插入物体感知与时代-国家一致性判断之间的差距，为这种行为提供了针对性的评估。

articles.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Linguistic Annotation
articles.abstract: Assessing large language models for linguistic annotation requires task-specific evaluation under documented conditions. We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface for exploring and sharing results. It records prompts, configurations and predictions, enabling comparisons of annotation quality, confidence calibration, repeatability and estimated cost. We demonstrate the framework and the associated methodology through 293 runs of 48 models on nine linguistic annotation tasks spanning morphology, syntax, semantics, discourse-pragmatics, spelling normalization and learner-language correction. Models achieve high agreement with reference annotations on several tasks, including those on non-standardized, historical varieties as well as requiring contextual interpretation. The results support evaluating models against specific linguistic tasks, rather than relying on general rankings. To this end, we make the current and future benchmarks publicly available at dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz.
articles.titleCn: 对大型语言模型进行语言标注基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型进行语言标注评估需要在明确条件下进行特定任务的测试。我们介绍了dhAIBench，这是一个带有网络界面的Python基准测试和标注工具，用于探索和共享结果。它记录提示、配置和预测，能够比较标注质量、置信度校准、可重复性和预估成本。我们通过在九种涵盖形态学、句法、语义、语篇语用学、拼写规范化和学习者语言纠正的语言标注任务上运行48个模型的293次运行，展示了该框架和相关方法。模型在多个任务上与参考标注高度一致，包括非标准化、历史变体以及需要上下文解释的任务。结果支持针对特定语言任务评估模型，而不是依赖通用排名。为此，我们将当前和未来的基准测试公开发布在dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz上。

articles.title: Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models
articles.abstract: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.

articles.titleCn: 经典结构先验改进了分子语言模型中的神经分子表示
articles.abstractCn: 经典分子相似性是化学信息系统中的核心，然而在结构-文本对数据上训练的分子语言模型并不一定能根据等级化的结构关系来组织分子嵌入。在此，我们引入结构感知引导对齐（SAGA），这是一种仅用于训练的正则化方法，它使用中心核对齐将神经分子表示与基于指纹的Tanimoto相似性对齐，而无需添加参数或要求推理时使用指纹。在MolCA和Atomas中，SAGA提高了分子-文本检索性能，将非精确检索转向更接近的结构类似物，并增加了平均骨架分割性质预测性能，同时在单次运行消融实验中，分子描述和文本到分子生成得到了改进或保持。这些结果表明，已建立的化学信息学先验可以使分子语言表示更符合化学特性，同时保留其多模态效用。

articles.title: The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning
articles.abstract: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\llκ\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.

articles.titleCn: 选择示例的代价：自适应情境学习中的情境过拟合
articles.abstractCn: 上下文学习通常被分析为在为学习者选择之前，提示中的示例已被采样。但在部署系统中并非如此：在看到查询和数据存储后，示例会被检索、过滤、重新排序、编辑和反复测试。我们通过将提示构建视为条件随机核微积分中的自适应数据分析来形式化这一差距。我们的主要量是上下文容量，即数据存储与最终提示转录之间的互信息或近似最大信息。对于任何冻结的上下文学习者和任何具有容量 κ 的自适应上下文管道，我们证明了一个有限样本上下文泛化界限，其阶数为 √(κ/k)，其中 k 是其损失构成报告分数的选定示例的数量。我们证明了一个匹配的下界，当 log k ≪ κ ≪ k 时，其常数是精确的，并推导出两种 PAC-Bayesian 检索规则：一种一阶吉布斯规则，为数据相关的候选门分配先验质量，以及一种自归一化的二阶规则。在 Banking77 上，具有 64 种检索配方和两个模型家族，证书在所有 24,000 次重采样选择事件中都成立，并且从 64 个（Qwen2.5-7B）或 128 个（GPT-4.1-mini）重用的验证查询中，吉布斯规则在超过 99% 的验证抽取中认证了风险低于零样本误差。最后，我们将理论应用于贝叶斯线性上下文回归，包括对查询对齐的 top-k 高斯检索的顺序统计量分析。结果将上下文质量与上下文认证区分开来：更长或更相关的上下文只有在选择它们的程序足够稳定，使得选定上下文的证据能够转移时，才会降低风险。

articles.title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
articles.abstract: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.
articles.titleCn: 信念流：通过潜在信念动态激发集体智能
articles.abstractCn: 在这项工作中，我们将多智能体推理视为寻求隐式信念动态的集体均衡的过程，并引入信念流（SoB），其中智能体维持连续的潜在信念，并通过沟通和反思迭代地完善它们。我们的方法寻求多智能体系统的一个集体信念状态，在该状态下，进一步的沟通不会导致有意义的信息传播。通过广泛的实验，我们证明了SoB在任务和模型家族中的泛化能力。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，在信念动态方面扩展多智能体推理提供了一个新的视角。

articles.title: Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
articles.abstract: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.
