articles.titleCn: 随时有效的自适应测试时缩放 PAC-Bayes 证书
articles.abstractCn: 测试时缩放系统通常在反复检查校准集后选择采样量、使用哪种提示以及信任哪种验证器或聚合规则。这种自适应选择后，标准的验证误差条不再有效。我们将测试时缩放方法建模为一个具有随机成本的随机预测器，并证明一个时间统一的PAC-Bayes证书，该证书同时适用于所有校准时间、所有关于方法的后验混合以及所有数据相关的停止规则。因此，同一个事件覆盖了部署前的方法搜索，而不仅仅是最终报告的固定方法。对于有限的预算和验证器网格，惩罚是熟悉的$\log M/n$，在最坏情况下，没有任何证书能在选择后保持有效，而非均匀先验和局部化的后验混合可以为结构化搜索提供更精确的证书。我们将结果专门化到自洽性，并展示一个互补的边际定律：多数投票仅在正确答案是生成器唯一模式的示例上才随样本预算呈指数级改进；否则，更多的计算可以证明会放大错误。相同的边际分析给出了计算分配的预言机填充定律。一个合成审计量化了自适应预算选择带来的乐观主义，一个使用gpt-4.1-mini生成的192示例GSM8K审计说明了真实推理管道的风险成本报告。在规模上，对于GSM8K和MATH-500上的两个模型，选中的最佳误差条在高达22.5%的随机分割中低于分割外的GSM8K风险，名义上为5%，而证书从未如此，在完整的GSM8K测试分割上，它收紧到0.109（保留风险为0.039）。这些结果提供了一种轻量级、无分布的方法来报告自适应推理系统的风险和计算声明。

articles.title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
articles.abstract: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型代理人的信念可以通过开放信道中的真实证据进行操纵
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理人的信念可以通过社交媒体等开放渠道被操纵，即使他们接收到的信息是真实的。当代理人在片段之间填充自我诱导的关系时，他们可能会将这些关系视为既定事实，并将由此产生的谣言传播给他人。基于叙事理解认知理论和蒙太奇电影理论，我们引入了生成式蒙太奇，通过协调代理人对真实片段进行排列组合，以实现这种被称为叙事过度拟合的失败。在六个推特事件中的1,090个谣言目标中，代理人往往过度自信地接受谣言，在十四个模型中的十二个模型中，接受率总体超过65%。在多数投票或对相同证据的审查后，接受率仍然保持在50%以上，这显示了错误如何影响下游决策。为了解释这种易感性，片段干预识别出在完整叙事中影响信念的帖子。合成控制随后表明，类似的响应模式源于有效证据，从而将信念影响与证据支持区分开来。这种区别促使我们提出了一个概念验证型神经符号运行时监控器——基础监控器，该监控器检查直接证据支持以指导代理人的判断，在原始和匿名化设置中，决策准确率提高了5.6至29.0个百分点。这些发现揭示了谣言放大的认知途径，并支持在代理人生成的结论指导公共决策之前监控推断的关系。

articles.title: A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications
articles.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.
articles.titleCn: 基于生成式AI的全屋智能服务架构：边缘模型、内存管理与家庭应用
articles.abstractCn: 生成式人工智能正进入家庭。基于云的助手在数据传输、持续可用性和物理操作可靠性方面面临治理限制，这在设备保持在线、数据随时间积累以及命令触发现实世界动作的家庭中尤为突出。本文以家庭本地服务器为统一的组织轴，构建了一个以设计为导向的综述框架。通过搜索截至2026年11月的arXiv、CNKI、ACL Anthology和官方文档，并将资料编码为五个证据类别：综述、系统原型、基准测试、人机交互和老年护理研究、官方文档。系统设计被映射到共享的架构模块上，识别出家庭本地服务器的九个重复责任。生成式模型支持感知解释、意图理解和候选计划，而确定性验证、知识图谱约束和授权租约将候选动作限制在一个可检查的空间内。家庭控制、情感陪伴和智能守护可以在一个共同框架内进行比较：它们共享状态和记忆，但在延迟、误报率和误漏率、主动性和权限方面存在差异。现有的基准测试依赖于虚拟环境，无法替代真实部署评估。本地部署并不天生更安全，仅靠技术连续性并不能确立陪伴和守护的社会或医疗效果。本文提出了一个涵盖架构能力、系统资源、隐私、安全性和可靠性以及人机体验的五维评估框架，并提出了本地优先智能家庭系统的六项设计原则和未来研究议程。

articles.title: Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence
articles.abstract: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. These findings demonstrate learnable confidence-related granularity adaptation, with benefits varying by model.
articles.titleCn: 教会语言模型根据其置信度调整答案粒度
articles.abstractCn: 当精确细节不确定时，一个较粗略的答案可以在不猜测或不回避的情况下保留有用信息。我们研究了语言模型是否可以通过基于样本响应一致性以及在不同粒度级别上识别答案的模型条件监督来学习这种行为。我们在时间、地理问题以及三个泛化数据集上评估了LFM2.5-1.2B、Minstral~3~3B、Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma~4~31B。在多个领域特定设置中，微调在将基础答案粗化为最佳固定水平方面，进一步提升了正确性与信息性的平衡。在泛化数据集上，所有四个模型在基础模型置信度较低时，更频繁地生成较粗略的答案。当同时考虑正确性和粒度时，这三个较小模型的答案在保留的关联关系上也优于基础响应。这些发现表明，存在可学习的与置信度相关的粒度自适应行为，且其效益因模型而异。

articles.title: Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education
articles.abstract: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.
articles.titleCn: 验证基于大型语言模型的作文评分器：医学教育中批判性在线推理的比较分析
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自动化作文评分器（AES）承诺达到人类水平的准确性。然而，针对特定评估任务训练、微调和评估LLM的成本高昂。特别是，人们开始质疑这些AES是否应该针对特定领域进行训练，还是基于通用LLM的模型可能就足够了。相比之下，人工标注通常更准确，但成本要高得多。本研究评估了基于通用LLM的AES系统集合是否可以通过利用编码的语言和概念知识来近似医学教育写作任务的人工评分。目标是评估通用模型是否适用于辅助或潜在替代该领域的人工标注。我们实验了11个AES系统和8种不同的LLM，并使用7位人工标注者进行的2076次评估来评价12项任务中的668份学生回答。这些评分被汇总以创建可用于训练AES输出分类器的目标类别。我们的结果表明，基于人工评分的学习类别可以通过在少量AES特征上训练的线性SVM准确重建。单个分类器在任务和领域之间表现良好，其中推理和内容特征最具预测性。这表明，即使是未经领域特定微调的现成LLM，也能支持医学教育的自动作文评分。虽然单个AES系统单独使用是不够的，但它们的组合近似于人工评估者，表明减少人工评分的需求或通过自动化方法补充人工评分的必要性。

articles.title: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
articles.abstract: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.
articles.titleCn: 看见不等于解决：基于对话基础的语言和视觉歧义消除
articles.abstractCn: 视觉定位基准测试通常不考虑现实场景中的上下文不确定性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个新的基准测试，即日语对话式模糊视觉定位评估数据集（JAG-D）。该数据集包含涵盖不同类型模糊性的、涉及视觉和语言类别的、人机对话式多模态交互。我们评估了不同最先进视觉语言模型（VLMs）在模糊性识别和解决方面的能力。我们比较了视觉和语言模糊性解决方面的对话上下文定位性能。我们的实验表明，VLMs可以通过使用对话上下文显著提高语言模糊性的解决能力，尤其是日语零指代。我们进一步进行了比较分析，以了解定位改进是否源于对话的语义内容，还是源于其对话结构。

articles.title: TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System
articles.abstract: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 时间序列故障诊断中的工具增强推理：电力管理系统
articles.abstractCn: 在运行多个负载的电源管理系统中，故障诊断依赖于专家手动检查电流和电压波形，这种方法无法扩展到已部署的设备。我们提出了TRACK，它将时间序列编码器与小型语言模型相结合，生成结构化、基于物理原理的诊断报告，并调用工具进行精确、可验证的计算。它可在设备上运行，保持专有传感器数据本地化，避免昂贵的API调用。我们引入了一个基于标准的框架，通过评分结构、信号保真度、物理推理、诊断结果和可操作性等标准来评估这些报告。在一个包含15个类别的多负载模拟基准测试中，TRACK实现了超过95%的故障类别准确率，并能泛化到分布外故障，而最佳的编码器探测基线准确率仅为58%。

articles.title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
articles.abstract: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.
articles.titleCn: PlainPairs：一个配对美国处方药标签中医生处方文本和患者文本语料库
articles.abstractCn: 在美国，处方药会附带针对处方医生的标签，许多药物还会附带针对患者的文字说明：药物指南或患者包装说明书。这两种文字针对同一药物，面向不同的读者，但公共资源很少将它们并置展示。我介绍了PlainPairs，这是一个基于公开FDA药物标签文件构建的开源语料库。0.1.0版本包含35,177个附带患者文字的处方标签，21,416个不同的患者文字，250,829个与处方医生部分通过监管标题匹配的患者文字片段，以及双边的阅读水平测量和基于规则的平实语言用词计数。第二个来源是美国国家癌症研究所的癌症信息摘要，增加了756份健康专业人士和患者版本的英文和西班牙文摘要。根据标签结构测量，中位数的药物指南按Flesch-Kincaid分级为8.7级，按SMOG分级为11.1级。在批量文件提供的扁平化文本上测量时，这些指南的等级略高两级，这一差异源于列表和标题边界的丢失。患者文字中有41%的句子直接面向读者，而处方医生部分仅为0.2%。对100对文本的盲法手检支持了十种标题类型中七种的基于标题的匹配。该语料库、其代码和文档都是公开的，发布版本将显示公司版权标记的文本排除在文本表格之外。

articles.title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
articles.abstract: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-recommendation.
articles.titleCn: 编辑建议：大型语言模型能否预见用户的编辑请求，以及何时预见？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理生成工件后，用户通常会对其进行编辑请求。本文研究了LLM是否能在请求发送前预见到这些请求。这种预见在实际应用中很有用，因为它减少了用户审查和反馈的工作量。我们将这项任务形式化为编辑推荐，并基于WildChat-4.8M的真实世界对话日志构建了EditRecBench，这是一个用于评估LLM在此任务上性能的基准。通过基准测试和失败分析，我们识别出在实际场景中存在一些情况本质上难以预测的实用挑战。为解决这一问题，我们引入了基于决策模型的门控机制，在向用户展示预测结果前过滤掉那些不太可能正确的预测案例。我们的训练模型优于现有的决策模型，并在门控阈值下将展示建议的pass@5指标提升了12至25个百分点。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-recommendation获取。

articles.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
articles.abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.
articles.titleCn: 从仓库到训练环境：通过环境演化循环扩展长时程编码智能体
articles.abstractCn: 训练用于长时程任务的编码智能体需要具有可验证反馈的环境。现有的流程通常遵循一个以验证结束的线性过程，这确立了可用性但很少提供关于改进训练价值的指导。递归自我改进（RSI）通常需要模型部署或模型训练后进行下游评估，在长时程任务中，成本和反馈延迟被放大。我们如何利用及时、可靠的代理信号来提高训练价值并大规模合成环境？我们提出了RepoFactory，这是一个自动化流程，将真实代码库转换为可验证环境，其中智能体根据语言规范从零开始构建完整项目。其环境进化循环通过代理反馈优化一个结合了有效性、结构耦合和实现范围的多重目标。RepoFactory在17个软件领域生成了10,159个环境。在这些问题环境中训练Qwen3.5-35B-A3B产生了RepoHorizen-35B-A3B，与未进行环境进化相比，它在NL2Repo-Bench上提升了22.6个百分点，在涵盖现实生产环境中长时程编码和智能体任务的五个基准测试中平均提升了8.5个百分点。这些结果突出了RepoFactory环境的训练价值以及环境进化循环带来的额外收益。

articles.title: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
articles.abstract: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.
articles.titleCn: SWE-WhatIf：模拟从录制的会话中获取的编码代理的真实用户
articles.abstractCn: 用户与代码代理之间的录制会话提供了一种评估代理完成现实任务和与用户交互方式的方法。然而，这些会话不能简单地用新代理重播，因为当代理采取不同轨迹时，录制的用户回复可能不再适用。我们引入了SWE-WhatIf，它通过建模用户的意图、满足这些意图的标准以及它们产生的条件，使用新代理重播录制会话。利用该模型，用户模拟器生成适应未见过代理回合的回复，同时保持与录制的关联。在89个现实会话中，SWE-WhatIf生成的回复与真实用户的回复最为相似，并且在会话重写时与最强的基线匹配。为测试适应性，我们重播了指示代理避免或重复用户在录制中提出反对的行为的会话。SWE-WhatIf在避免这些行为方面产生了最高的胜率（66.3%），显著高于随机水平。我们进一步通过将五个LLM作为代码代理进行排名来展示其效用，其中排名最高的模型取决于用户如何指定和发展他们的意图，以及一个涉及16名用户的研究，其中重播他们自己的会话改变了14名参与者的排名，并指导了他们未来的代理使用。

articles.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. At each generation, ELITE proposes diverse focused improvements, implements them independently from the same parent, and inspects the resulting programs to identify complementary, redundant, and conflicting mechanisms before reimplementing a compatible subset as one coherent descendant. No downstream task outcomes or task-solving trajectories of evolved candidates are used to guide evolution; only deterministic checks of structural and operational validity are used inside the loop. On SWE-bench Pro, ELITE improves the initial agent from 60.0% to 85.6%, compared with 86.7% for the Darwin Godel Machine (DGM) and 88.3% for the Huxley-Godel Machine (HGM), while using zero candidate task evaluations and reducing observed wall-clock evolution time by 8.8x and 3.2x, respectively, under the evaluated configurations. In cross-benchmark transfer without further adaptation, ELITE averages 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 69.3% on Polyglot. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of coding-agent self-improvement without downstream candidate task evaluation in our setting.
articles.titleCn: 无评估递归自我改进的编码代理
articles.abstractCn: 近期，通过迭代修改自身可执行实现，自改进编码代理在基准测试中取得了优异表现。一种常见模式是利用下游任务产生的证据来决定哪些候选者或谱系继续进化，我们称之为评估与选择。获取这一信号需要反复在下游任务上执行进化代理，因此更广泛的探索会导致评估成本增加，而针对固定评估分布的重复优化可能会鼓励针对基准测试的特定适应。我们提出的问题是：编码代理能否在进化循环内部无需下游任务评估进行自改进？我们引入了探索后集成（ELITE）方法，该方法集成实现机制，而非选择单个探索性子代继续谱系。在每个代中，ELITE提出多样化的聚焦改进，独立地从同一父代实现它们，并检查生成的程序以识别互补、冗余和冲突的机制，然后重新实现兼容的子集作为一个连贯的后代。进化循环内部仅使用结构性和操作性的确定性检查来指导进化，而不使用下游任务结果或进化候选者的任务解决轨迹。在SWE-bench Pro上，ELITE将初始代理从60.0%提升至85.6%，而达尔文哥德尔机（DGM）和休利-哥德尔机（HGM）分别达到86.7%和88.3%，同时使用零候选任务评估，并在评估配置下将观察到的墙钟进化时间分别减少了8.8倍和3.2倍。在无需进一步适应的跨基准迁移中，ELITE在SWE-bench Verified上平均达到73.3%，在Polyglot上达到69.3%。综合这些结果，证明了在我们的设置下，编码代理无需下游候选任务评估即可进行自改进的可行性。

articles.title: MemDoctor: Stage-wise Error Attribution and Repair for MLLM Agent Memory
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now assist users across sessions of images and text, carried by an external memory of what was said and shown. When such an assistant answers wrongly, the failure usually began earlier, in how a record was written, updated or retrieved, and the answer alone does not say where. We formalize multimodal memory as four stages, Write, Update, Retrieve and Answer, and define nine error types across them. A stage-resolved analysis on Mem-Gallery traces most failures to a source stage, and most of those lie before the answer. Injecting known errors against fact-preserving control edits, we then follow each tainted record downstream. Early errors survive to the answer as apparent evidence, and hurt most when no other record holds the fact. A diagnosis that trusts the quoted evidence therefore blames the stage where the error surfaces, not the one where it began. We propose MemDoctor, in which the MLLM that built the memory diagnoses its own failures. It traces each needed fact backward through the four stages, accepts a diagnosis only when the cited evidence is found in memory, and repairs that stage before answering again. On a 4B backbone, MemDoctor improves accuracy on both Mem-Gallery and MemLens, outperforming all evaluated 8B baselines, and the same loop also improves MuRAG and A-Mem.
articles.titleCn: MemDoctor：针对MLLM智能体内存的逐步错误归因与修复
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）现在通过外部记忆——记录了之前所说的和所展示的内容——在图像和文本的不同会话中协助用户。当这样的助手回答错误时，问题通常源于更早的阶段，即记录的写入、更新或检索方式，而单独的答案并不能指出问题所在。我们将多模态记忆形式化为四个阶段：写入（Write）、更新（Update）、检索（Retrieve）和回答（Answer），并定义了这四个阶段中的九种错误类型。对Mem-Gallery的阶段性分析表明，大多数错误可以追溯到某个源阶段，而其中大部分发生在回答之前。我们通过向事实保持控制的编辑注入已知错误，然后追踪每个受污染记录的下游路径。早期的错误会以明显证据的形式存活到回答阶段，并在没有其他记录持有事实时造成最大伤害。因此，信任所引用证据的诊断会归咎于错误暴露的阶段，而非其起始阶段。我们提出了MemDoctor，其中构建记忆的MLLM诊断自身的错误。它通过四个阶段逆向追踪每个所需事实，只有在引用的证据在记忆中找到时才接受诊断，并在再次回答前修复该阶段。在4B主干网络上，MemDoctor在Mem-Gallery和MemLens上提高了准确性，超越了所有评估的8B基线，并且相同的循环也提升了MuRAG和A-Mem的表现。

articles.title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
articles.abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.
articles.comment: Accepted to Ml4H 2026 Accepted to GenAI4H workshop @ Neurips 2026
articles.titleCn: 声音重要吗？评估部署临床语音代理通话中的挫败感检测
articles.abstractCn: 自主语音代理现在负责进行常规的临床随访电话，因此一些自动化分诊是不可避免的。患者表现出沮丧是分诊应该捕捉到的情况。这些系统通常只读取语音转文本阶段产生的文本，而不是语音本身，而这种做法在真实临床语音上的有效性尚未得到充分测试。我们研究了部署的临床语音代理的真实患者通话中的每轮沮丧检测：六个由三位标注员标记的电话，共150轮，以及一个长度匹配的表演语料库作为对照，还有30个电话的714轮数据。患者的发言通常非常简短：在部署的电话中，大约59%是单个或两个词，而在完整的表演语料库中只有13%，即使表演语料库的长度被匹配后，语料库准确率差距仍然存在。在单个词发言中，仅文本检测无法排除偶然性。在五个支持音频的语言模型中，表演的30个电话中有39个沮丧的单词发言中，文本标记了3到4个，而仅给定词数的分类器达到了57.3%。音频是否有助于检测取决于模型和指令。当被要求关注表达方式时，两个Gemini 2.5模型在30个电话中比文本提高了3.0个百分点（-1.0到7.5个百分点）。在这些模型自信排除的发言中，6.9%实际上是沮丧的（音频）与13.0%（文本），差异为6.1个百分点（2.2到10.4个百分点）。在30个电话中，给定一个对两个输入都相同的提示，没有模型的音频-文本间隔排除零。在特定输入提示下，一个较新的Gemini模型和两个较小的开放模型在音频上的表现比文本更差（-3.5、-8.6和-10.6个百分点）。一个在临床电话上训练的WavLM探测器总体上与最佳提示模型匹配（71.6%），但在额外添加的24个电话中遗漏了每一个沮丧的单词发言。当患者的发言简短时，仅文本不足以排除沮丧。

articles.title: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
articles.abstract: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 questions: 353 form the learning history and 146 are held out and never used to update the context layer. Bootstrapping alone improves overall accuracy by +4.6 percentage points. Learning only from the history raises accuracy on the untouched held-out transfer set by +22.6 points (95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]), exceeding five-shot retrieval from the same history by +12.3 points. Incremental learning reaches the one-shot endpoint within observed evaluation noise on every database. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.
articles.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents. Data splits and annotations: https://github.com/varunagrawal2002/Living-Context-Graph
articles.titleCn: 生活情境图：企业数据推理的持续语义学习
articles.abstractCn: 企业AI现在可以执行分析、报告和数据驱动的工作流程，但其依赖的数据基础仍然难以实现运营化：业务含义、关系、指标定义和报告规范都缺失在数据库模式中，并且散布在未记录的系统和技术传统知识中。我们介绍了“动态上下文图”（LCG），这是一个持续学习的上下文层，它使现有的企业数据对AI可操作，而无需复制或转换底层仓库。LCG从数据本身启动基础语义和关系，构建一个概念图来索引业务上下文，在查询服务时写入持久的语义学习成果，并在后续结果与先前路径矛盾时撤回或重新获取上下文。我们通过文本到SQL任务评估LCG，这是一个核心数据推理任务，在三个包含499个问题的BIRD数据库的迁移感知拆分上：353个问题构成学习历史，146个问题被排除且从未用于更新上下文层。仅启动就能将整体准确率提高4.6个百分点。仅从历史中学习将未受影响的排除集准确率提高22.6个百分点（95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]），超过从同一历史中五次射击检索多12.3个百分点。增量学习在每个数据库上都在观察到的评估噪声内达到单次射击终点。移除图对排除集准确率的影响最多每个数据库一个问题，但将每条查询成本增加2.3-3.3倍，中位数延迟增加1.8-3.4倍：持续学习的语义驱动准确率，而图使上下文服务高效。

articles.title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard classifiers share this blind spot, and even frontier LLM judges catch at most one of 10 human-labeled confident misses. Without a trained reward model, the probability reward with a helpfulness term lowers HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B from 0.287 to at most 0.033 at the final checkpoint.
articles.titleCn: Jev-as-a-Reward：验证强化学习中的概率安全法官
articles.abstractCn: 概率安全裁判者返回安全标签的概率，并能以低成本评分强化学习部署。置信度门将仅不确定的裁决发送给更强大的LLM裁判，而将自信通过的危害留在盲区。策略可以利用这个盲区，商业裁判会发布新版本。我们提出了一种协议，在训练前和训练期间验证此类裁判，将其自信通过的危害份额与其数量分离，并在每次裁判变更后重新验证。我们将其应用于Jev的两个商业决策裁判版本和一个开放防护分类器。在Jev的概率奖励下，所有11次运行中通过的危害在主要参考下均减少，且减少速度通常慢于被捕获的危害，并集中在盲区。将该裁判二值化在Llama上满足逃逸标准，开放防护分类器在第二个参考下的一种种子中显示出逃逸信号。防护分类器共享这个盲区，即使是前沿LLM裁判最多只能捕获10个人类标记的自信遗漏之一。没有训练好的奖励模型，带有帮助性项的概率奖励将Llama-3.1-8B的HarmBench攻击成功率从0.287降低到最终检查点时的最多0.033。

articles.title: Navital Gym: Rule-Graded Agent Environments for Indian Workflows
articles.abstract: AI agents are being deployed on Indian workflows such as payments, tax, forms, travel and customer support in Hindi and Hinglish. Public agent evaluations rarely cover these workflows, and many score with another language model. We present Navital Gym, a set of six open environments with 321 public tasks in five task families: trip planning, UPI payments and disputes, GST invoicing and returns, form filling (including a multi-document split) and customer support in Hindi, Hinglish and three experimental Indian languages. Every task is graded by named, deterministic rules that recompute the outcome from a synthetic sandbox world. No language model judges any score. We report one run per task for three models on all six environments, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5, and for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on two (UPI and the Support core). Opus solves 315 of 321 tasks, Sonnet 302 and Haiku 205. Trip planning and Hindi/Hinglish support separate the models most. We also describe a private held-out set that is not published, and a 7B adapter trained in the gym. Code is Apache-2.0 and task data is CC BY 4.0. The rules are a documented simplification of Indian practice, not the live systems.
articles.titleCn: Navital健身房：针对印度工作流程的规则分级代理环境
articles.abstractCn: AI代理正在印度的工作流程中部署，包括支付、税务、表格、旅行和客户支持，使用印地语和印地英语。公共代理评估很少涵盖这些工作流程，许多评估使用另一种语言模型。我们介绍了Navital Gym，一套包含六个开放环境，涵盖五个任务系列：旅行计划、UPI支付和争议、GST开票和退税、表格填写（包括多文档拆分）以及印地语、印地英语和三种实验性印度语言的客户支持，共321个公共任务。每个任务都由命名、确定性的规则进行评分，这些规则从合成沙盒世界中重新计算结果。没有语言模型对任何评分进行评判。我们报告了三个模型在所有六个环境中的每个任务的一次运行结果：Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5和Claude Haiku 4.5，以及Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite在两个环境（UPI和支持核心）中的运行结果。Opus解决了321个任务中的315个，Sonnet解决了302个，Haiku解决了205个。旅行计划和印地语/印地英语支持最能区分这些模型。我们还描述了一个未发布的私有保留集，以及一个在Gym中训练的7B适配器。代码是Apache-2.0许可，任务数据是CC BY 4.0许可。这些规则是对印度实践的简化描述，而非实时系统。

articles.title: Experience Rot: Experienced Agents Fail Where Novices Succeed
articles.abstract: Agents are increasingly built to learn from experience: they keep conversation histories, memory files, retrieved notes and skills, and reuse what worked before. We show that this experience turns against them when their tools change silently. We test a range of models with tools defined as in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). After a silent change, experienced agents fail on most tasks, while agents new to the task mostly succeed. We call this failure Experience Rot. Experienced agents copy their earlier call instead of checking the current interface, even when the tool definition shows the change. Then they report success. When the documentation is incomplete, experience is what makes agents succeed. After a change, the same experience leaves them worse off than no experience at all. The failure appears in every form of memory we test and grows with the amount of experience. Simple remedies fall short: announcing the update barely helps, and pointing the agent to the documentation fails whenever the documentation does not spell out the answer.
articles.titleCn: 体验腐化：有经验的代理人在新手成功的地方失败
articles.abstractCn: 智能体正越来越多地被设计为从经验中学习：它们会保留对话历史、记忆文件、检索到的笔记和技能，并重用过去有效的方法。我们证明，当它们的工具发生无声变化时，这种经验反而会适得其反。我们测试了一系列在模型上下文协议（MCP）中定义的工具的模型。在发生无声变化后，有经验的智能体在大多数任务上失败，而新接触这项任务的智能体则大多成功。我们将这种失败称为“经验腐化”。有经验的智能体会复制它们早前的调用，而不是检查当前界面，即使工具定义显示了变化也是如此。然后它们会报告成功。当文档不完整时，经验反而使智能体成功。在变化之后，同样的经验让它们比没有经验的情况更糟糕。这种失败出现在我们测试的每一种记忆形式中，并且随着经验量的增加而加剧。简单的补救措施效果有限：宣布更新几乎没什么帮助，而将智能体指向文档时，只要文档没有明确说明答案，这种方法就会失败。

articles.title: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI.
articles.titleCn: 从递归到卷积：多智能体系统的并行自改进
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体自我改进通过交互和反馈实现提升，然而智能体间和改进轮次间的顺序依赖会传播错误、增加计算成本并限制并行性。此外，孤立地改进单个特征或智能体可能忽视其依赖关系并限制集体协调。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ConvRSI框架，通过卷积并行化多智能体自我改进。ConvRSI结合了智能体内卷积，联合改进相关智能体特征，以及智能体间图卷积，根据协作拓扑聚合信息。这两个阶段均在潜在空间中运行，实现并行更新而无需反复解码和编码中间信息。在MATH-500上的实验表明，与RecursiveMAS相比，ConvRSI性能提升5.04%，推理成本降低17.27%，延迟降低45.11%。它还通过将协作拓扑表示为邻接矩阵来支持多样化的协作模式。这些结果证明了卷积协同进化的潜力，为高效多智能体自我改进提供了可能。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI获取。

articles.title: It Depends on the Task: Rethinking Rhetorical Segmentation of Dutch Judicial Decisions
articles.abstract: Classifying the material facts, submissions, judicial reasoning, and the court's decision (rhetorical roles) in case law is a prerequisite for high-quality performance across virtually all NLP-in-law tasks, including legal information retrieval, summarisation, and LLM-based analysis. These rhetorical roles often intertwine and shift sentence by sentence, making reliable classification difficult. This paper introduces the first sentence-level annotated dataset of Dutch judicial decisions, labelled across four legally meaningful categories: material facts, submissions, judicial reasoning, and the court's decision, alongside non-annotated (None) content, and compares several classification strategies, including a staged pipeline that separates None detection from the rhetorical roles, and a Bayesian update that leverages information about the section-header a sentence belongs to. Our results show that no single strategy dominates on both precision and recall: header priors help most when the None sentences are excluded and offer little benefit for None detection itself. These trade-offs matter in practice. For instance, extractive summarisation depends more on recall so it does not miss relevant facts, whereas outcome prediction depends more on precision regarding decision and facts sentences so that the predicted ruling is not contaminated by noise. We use these trade-offs and map the approaches tested in this study onto a set of representative legal NLP use cases.
articles.titleCn: 任务而定：重新思考荷兰司法判决的修辞分割
articles.abstractCn: 在案例法中，对材料事实、提交内容、司法推理以及法院判决（修辞角色）进行分类，是几乎所有涉及法律的自然语言处理任务（包括法律信息检索、摘要生成和基于大型语言模型的分析）高质量表现的前提。这些修辞角色常常逐句交织和转换，使得可靠的分类变得困难。本文介绍了首个荷兰司法判决的句子级标注数据集，该数据集在四个具有法律意义的类别上进行标注：材料事实、提交内容、司法推理和法院判决，以及非标注（None）内容，并比较了多种分类策略，包括一个将None检测与修辞角色分离的阶段式流水线，以及一个利用句子所属章节标题信息的贝叶斯更新方法。我们的结果表明，没有单一策略在精确度和召回率上都能占优：当排除None句子时，章节标题先验信息最有帮助，但对于None检测本身却几乎没有益处。这些权衡在实际应用中具有重要意义。例如，抽取式摘要更依赖于召回率，以确保不遗漏相关事实，而结果预测则更依赖于判决和事实句的精确度，以避免预测的裁决被噪声干扰。我们利用这些权衡，并将本研究中测试的方法映射到一组具有代表性的法律自然语言处理应用场景。

articles.title: MolReps: Taking SELFIES, Making SMILES, Teaching LLMs
articles.abstract: The same molecule can be expressed in multiple, syntactically distinct representations, yet it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize and relate these equivalent encodings. We introduce MolReps, a pipeline that generates 9,600 question-answer pairs across ten representations for conversion, normalization, and 2D structure recognition. Post-training on MolReps improves text-only and multimodal models, MolQwen3-4B-Instruct (MQ3-4B-I) and MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (MQ3-VL-4B-I), from $4.01\%$ to $75.13\%$ and from $7.11\%$ to $73.14\%$ (InChIKey match) on the molecule-overlap test set, respectively. On the molecule-disjoint test set, post-training increased validity from $20.35\%$ to $58.12\%$ for MQ3-4B-I and from $17.19\%$ to $59.34\%$ for MQ3-VL-4B-I. However, InChIKey match remained low, decreasing from $3.86\%$ to $3.09\%$ and from $6.44\%$ to $2.29\%$, respectively. Furthermore, the resulting models achieve a relative $27.84\%$ improvement in average over their base model on MolRepBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating molecular property prediction. These results show the effectiveness of targeted post-training for enhancing molecular representation understanding and its potential to improve downstream molecular tasks.
articles.titleCn: MolReps：拍摄自拍、制造微笑、教授大语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 相同的分子可以以多种语法上不同的表示形式来表达，但目前尚不清楚大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能够识别和关联这些等价编码。我们引入了MolReps，这是一个生成10种表示形式的9,600个问答对的流程，用于转换、归一化和二维结构识别。在MolReps上进行后训练提升了纯文本和多模态模型，MolQwen3-4B-Instruct（MQ3-4B-I）和MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct（MQ3-VL-4B-I），在分子重叠测试集上的表现分别从4.01%提升至75.13%和7.11%提升至73.14%（InChIKey匹配）。在分子不重叠测试集上，后训练使MQ3-4B-I的有效性从20.35%提升至58.12%，MQ3-VL-4B-I的有效性从17.19%提升至59.34%。然而，InChIKey匹配率仍然较低，分别从3.86%降至3.09%和6.44%降至2.29%。此外，所得模型在MolRepBench（一个用于评估分子性质预测的综合基准）上相对于基础模型平均提升了27.84%。这些结果表明，针对性强后训练在增强分子表示理解方面的有效性及其在提升下游分子任务方面的潜力。

articles.title: EDITORS Know Your Style! Editing LoRA Subspaces for Stylistic Attribution and Imitation
articles.abstract: Disentangling writing style from semantic content is a fundamental challenge in literary text modeling. Style-content entanglement causes models to rely on semantic content for authorship attribution (AA) tasks and memorize author-specific content for style imitation (SI) tasks. We propose EDITORS (EditingLoRA Subspaces), a diagnose-then-deflate framework that adapts pretrained large language models and prioritizes stylistic features, making it effective for both AA and SI tasks. EDITORS first trains a diagnostic LoRA adapter using style-neutral statements derived from the training corpus to identify a content-oriented subspace. It then trains the final style adapter under activation-space deflation that projects input activations away from the identified content-oriented directions. We empirically demonstrate that EDITORS is effective. On three AA benchmarks spanning literature, social media, and news, EDITORS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming the strongest existing baseline by up to 29%. On SI, EDITORS generates stylistically faithful and diverse passages, outperforming baselines in achieving style similarity while adhering to content specifications.
articles.titleCn: 编辑们！了解你的风格！编辑LoRA子空间以进行风格归因和模仿
articles.abstractCn: 将写作风格与语义内容分离是文学文本建模中的一个基本挑战。风格-内容纠缠导致模型在作者归属（AA）任务中依赖语义内容，在风格模仿（SI）任务中记忆作者特定内容。我们提出了EDITORS（EditingLoRA Subspaces），这是一个诊断后再压缩的框架，它通过调整预训练的大型语言模型并优先考虑风格特征，使其在AA和SI任务中均有效。EDITORS首先使用从训练语料库中提取的风格中性语句训练一个诊断LoRA适配器，以识别面向内容的子空间。然后，在激活空间压缩下训练最终的风格适配器，将输入激活投影到已识别的面向内容方向之外。我们通过实验证明EDITORS是有效的。在涵盖文学、社交媒体和新闻的三个AA基准测试中，EDITORS达到了最先进的准确率，比最强的现有基线提高了29%。在SI方面，EDITORS生成的段落风格忠实且多样，在实现风格相似性的同时遵守内容规范，优于基线模型。

articles.title: DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
articles.abstract: Benchmarks judge language-model agents mainly by whether they reach the correct final state, not by how they got there. Endpoint scoring cannot separate an agent that retrieved exactly the evidence a decision required from one that read most of the environment, nor an agent that never located the evidence from one that stopped a single action short. Settling this needs a reference cost, and authored solutions establish only that a task is solvable, not that no shorter route exists. We present DetourBench, which constrains the environment until that minimum is computable. Each task is a finite, partially observable transition system with unit-cost accesses whose resources become globally addressable after discovery. Exhaustive search yields the full-information minimum action count $L_0$ with a replayable witness; from graph-recoverable terminal states it also yields exact residual work $R_T$, which separates an episode that stopped one access short from one that wandered, while an irreversible wrong commitment is recorded as having no finite residual distance rather than assigned one. Success, attainment, residual progress, and normalized detour are reported separately. Across 375 scored episodes --- five model endpoints, 25 integrated tasks, three repeats --- success ranges from 58.7% to 96.0% while conditional attainment ranges from 0.803 to 0.890 and orders the models differently. Among recoverable failures, residual work separates near-complete trajectories from costly incompletion and from irreversible commitment. We open-source the instances, oracle witnesses, and evaluation harness at https://github.com/DatagridsAI/DetourBench.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents
articles.titleCn: 绕行基准：交互式智能体轨迹级评估与精确最小动作界限
articles.abstractCn: 基准测试主要依据语言模型代理是否达到正确最终状态来评判，而非其达成过程。终点评分无法区分一个恰好检索到决策所需证据的代理和一个阅读了大部分环境的代理，也无法区分一个从未定位到证据的代理和一个仅差一个动作就无法停止的代理。解决这一问题需要参考成本，而人工编写的解决方案仅能证明任务可解，而非证明不存在更短路径。我们提出了DetourBench，该基准测试通过约束环境，直到最小值可计算。每个任务都是一个有限、部分可观察的转换系统，具有单位成本访问，其资源在发现后可全局寻址。穷举搜索可得出全信息最小动作计数$L_0$，并附带可重放的证据；从图可恢复的终端状态还可得出精确剩余工作量$R_T$，这可将一个仅差一次访问就无法完成的情节与一个漫无目的的情节区分开来，而不可逆的错误承诺则被记录为无有限剩余距离，而非被分配一个值。成功、达成、剩余进度和标准化绕路分别报告。在375个评分情节中——包括五个模型终点、25个集成任务、三次重复——成功率范围从58.7%到96.0%，条件达成率范围从0.803到0.890，并重新排序了模型。在可恢复的失败案例中，剩余工作量可将近乎完整的轨迹与代价高昂的不完整完成以及不可逆的承诺区分开来。我们开源了实例、预言机证据和评估框架，地址为https://github.com/DatagridsAI/DetourBench。

articles.title: Medical question answering collapses in Hausa: a pre-registered pilot on three small open models
articles.abstract: A system that reads nothing and always answers the most frequent letter scores \BaselineP{} on our Hausa medical multiple-choice set. \NBelowBaseline{} of the \NModels{} small open models we evaluate do not beat it. We lead with that because the usual summary of a multilingual result -- a percentage-point drop from English -- does not say whether what survives the drop is performance at all. On a paired English--Hausa set of \NEval{} MedMCQA items, three instruction-tuned models of 3--4B parameters lose between \GapMedGemma{} and \GapQwen{} points of accuracy, every gap significant after Holm correction. Back-translating the Hausa items into English recovers between half and two-thirds of the gap for the two general-purpose models but not demonstrably for the medically adapted one, so the deficit is substantially, though not wholly, a matter of the language of presentation. Answers are also far less stable: agreement across three option orderings falls from \ConsEnQwen{} to \ConsHaQwen{} in the worst case. An exploratory error analysis of \ENRows{} discordant items attributes most of the damage to medical vocabulary lost in translation (\ETerm{}, 95\% CI \ETermLo{}--\ETermHi{}), usually in the question stem. A fourth registered hypothesis proposed closing the gap with self-generated preference pairs. Its pilot gate found nothing to train on: asked to reason in Hausa rather than to pick a letter, the model echoes the prompt back, switches into Swahili, or simply stops without answering; only \GateParse{} of chains are parseable. We report that intervention as not run, which is itself the sharper result -- a forced-choice benchmark cannot see a model that has no generative command of the language at all. All hypotheses, thresholds and decision rules were registered before any model was run, and all deviations are logged.
articles.titleCn: 在哈уса语中医疗问答系统崩溃：一项关于三个小型开放模型的预注册试点研究
articles.abstractCn: 一个不读取任何内容且始终回答最频繁字母得分的系统 \BaselineP{} 在我们的豪萨语医学选择题数据集上表现最佳。在我们评估的 \NModels{} 个小型开放模型中，没有模型能超越它。我们首先提出这一点，因为多语言结果通常的总结——与英语相比的百分点下降——并不能说明下降后是否还有性能。在一个包含 \NEval{} 个 MedMCQA 项目的英语-豪萨语配对数据集上，三个参数量为 3-4B 的指令微调模型准确率分别下降了 \GapMedGemma{} 和 \GapQwen{} 百分点，且每个差距在 Holm 校正后都具有显著性。将豪萨语项目回译为英语，对于两个通用模型可恢复约一半到三分之二的差距，但对于医学适配模型则没有明显效果，因此这种缺陷主要（尽管不是全部）在于呈现语言的差异。答案的稳定性也大大降低：在最坏情况下，三个选项顺序的一致性从 \ConsEnQwen{} 下降到 \ConsHaQwen{}。对 \ENRows{} 个不一致项目的探索性错误分析表明，大部分损失归因于翻译中丢失的医学词汇（\ETerm{}, 95% CI \ETermLo{}--\ETermHi{}），通常出现在问题主干中。第四个注册假设提出通过自我生成的偏好对来缩小差距。其试点门控发现没有可训练的内容：被要求用豪萨语进行推理而不是选择字母时，模型会重复提示内容、切换到斯瓦希里语，或直接停止不回答；只有 \GateParse{} 的链是可解析的。我们报告该干预未执行，这本身就是更尖锐的结果——一个强制选择基准无法识别一个完全缺乏语言生成能力的模型。所有假设、阈值和决策规则在运行任何模型之前都已注册，所有偏差都已记录。

articles.title: CuRSE-Bench: A Benchmark for Probing Cultural Blind Spots in Text-to-Image Safety Evaluation
articles.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) safety evaluation typically assigns each prompt or image a single culture-blind harm label, so content that is harmful only within a particular culture can pass as benign. We introduce CultureCraft, an agentic framework that constructs T2I prompts that appear benign under a general-purpose rubric yet carry a latent harmful meaning in a target culture, and use it to build CuRSE-Bench: 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 culture-general controls over six regions and ten harm axes, each drawn from a predefined knowledge base of documented harm vectors and traceable to at least two independent sources. Scoring every prompt under six region persona judges and a paired culture-blind judge, we find that the culture-blind judge under-rates culture-specific latent harm while matching the persona judges on the controls. Each persona judge, in turn, chiefly decodes its own region's latent harm under our instrument: a selective cultural blind spot that persists in deployed moderators.
articles.titleCn: CuRSE-Bench：用于检测文本到图像安全评估中文化盲点的基准
articles.abstractCn: 文本到图像（T2I）安全评估通常会给每个提示或图像分配一个文化盲目的危害标签，因此仅在一个特定文化中具有危害性的内容可能会被误判为无害。我们引入了CultureCraft，这是一个主动式框架，用于构建在通用标准下看似无害的T2I提示，但在目标文化中却蕴含潜在危害性。我们利用该框架构建了CuRSE-Bench：包含10,709个文化特定提示和2,648个文化通用控制项，覆盖六大区域和十个危害维度，每个提示均来自一个预定义的、包含已记录危害向量的知识库，并至少可追溯至两个独立来源。我们对每个提示在六大区域角色评判者和一名配对的文化盲目评判者下进行评分，发现文化盲目评判者低估了文化特定潜在危害，但在控制项上与角色评判者评分一致。而每个角色评判者则主要根据我们的工具解码其所在区域的潜在危害——这是一种在已部署的审核者中持续存在的选择性文化盲点。

articles.title: What Do Digital Traces Predict? Task Effects, Student Differences, and Critical Online Reasoning
articles.abstract: Digital assessment traces are increasingly used to predict student performance, often evaluated by correlating predicted and observed scores pooled across tasks. However, such correlations may reflect between-task differences rather than performance differences among students within tasks. To investigate this, we analyzed up to 527 browsing sessions from 424 university students completing open-Internet Critical Online Reasoning tasks and assessed the cross-task stability of their ratings. We evaluated the same out-of-fold predictions within and across tasks, compared three validation tiers up to leave-one-task-out, and tested incremental predictive contributions of consultation order and relational structure against matched permutation and randomization controls. None of the twelve prespecified primary tests was significant: on held-out tasks, consulted-page features showed no significant association with relative student performance, nor did observed order or relational structure add predictive value. Pooling observations across tasks substantially increased correlations, particularly for factual correctness, whose scores showed limited evidence of stable between-student differences across tasks. However, sentence embeddings yielded modest positive correlations with generic response quality on held-out tasks, without establishing added predictive value from observed order or relational structure. Our findings show that pooled predictive correlations may not reflect within-task student differences, highlighting the need for within-task evaluation and criterion generalizability audits.
articles.titleCn: 数字痕迹预测什么？任务效应、学生差异与批判性在线推理
articles.abstractCn: 数字评估轨迹越来越多地被用于预测学生表现，通常通过将跨任务的预测分数和观测分数进行关联来评估。然而，这种关联可能反映的是任务间的差异，而非任务内学生间的表现差异。为了研究这一点，我们分析了424名大学生完成开放式互联网批判性在线推理任务时产生的多达527个浏览会话，并评估了他们评分的跨任务稳定性。我们在任务内和跨任务中评估了相同的出模型预测，比较了从留一任务出到留多任务出的三级验证，并测试了咨询顺序和关系结构的增量预测贡献，同时与匹配的置换和随机化控制进行了比较。十二项预设的主要测试均未发现显著结果：在留出的任务中，咨询页面的特征与学生的相对表现没有显著关联，观测到的顺序或关系结构也没有增加预测价值。跨任务合并观察值显著增加了相关性，特别是在事实准确性方面，其分数在任务间没有充分证据表明存在稳定的学生间差异。然而，句子嵌入在留出任务上与通用响应质量产生了适度的正相关，但没有从观测到的顺序或关系结构中建立额外的预测价值。我们的研究表明，合并的预测相关性可能无法反映任务内的学生差异，突出了任务内评估和标准泛化审计的必要性。

articles.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
