articles.titleCn: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB：一个开放高效的轻量级语言模型，适用于快速对话代理
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，这是一个开源且高效的微型语言模型，由Gemma-4-E4B-it进一步微调而成，并针对每GB内存使用的速度和智能进行了优化，用于快速对话代理。该模型继承了Gemma强大的对话能力，并进一步提升了多轮工具使用、指令遵循和输入基础能力，适用于快速本地语音/设备助手、交互式角色和嵌入式/边缘界面。该模型结合了自然对话和多轮代理能力，为在GeForce RTX、Jetson和RTX/DGX Spark上运行的语音/设备助手、交互式角色和机器人/IoT界面提供动力。在21个基准测试中，与Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.5-4B相比，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB在推理和非推理模式下均实现了最高平均准确率，同时生成的输出token数量最少。该模型配备了DFlash生成器。借助DFlash，Bolt E4B在并发度~1时，无推测解码的推理解码速度比传统推理快2.74倍，在批处理大小为1时，生成吞吐量比Gemma-4-E4B-it使用MTP时快1.21倍。

articles.title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
articles.abstract: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.
articles.titleCn: LLMs中针对长期记忆的即时重量-空间整合
articles.abstractCn: 代理式记忆系统通过将经验提取为文本并在查询时检索，为大型语言模型提供持久记忆，但模型本身并未进化：无论其交互次数多少，每次查询都从相同的状态开始。提取错误会累积，隐式的跨会话模式无法通过单个片段呈现，且构建成本随每次对话增长。基于过去交互的微调确实会改变权重，但需要在服务时进行反向传播，并在长历史记录上性能下降。我们引入了CLAM（携带潜在适配器记忆），它结合了两种方法的优点：一个循环超网络执行参数化整合，通过单次前向传递将会话激活流编译成一个低秩适配器，无需梯度步进和语言模型生成调用，而一个互补的事件缓冲区则在推理时提供逐字细节。一个门控潜在状态在会话间携带知识，因此参数化记忆可以累积而不增长。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上，针对三个开放模型（参数量2-7B），CLAM比所有代理式基线领先1-45分，比所有基于梯度的参数化方法领先10-45分，同时无需任何生成式LLM调用、无需梯度步进，且构建记忆所需的墙钟时间比提取系统少3-151倍。这两个通道是互补的：当事件缓冲区遗漏黄金证据时，整合适配器仍能增加12-15分精度，即使使用预言机缓冲区，也能增加4-5分。

articles.title: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
articles.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.
articles.titleCn: GPRM：全局视角过程奖励模型
articles.abstractCn: 过程奖励模型（PRMs）被广泛用于大型语言模型中多步推理的步骤级评估，但现有方法常受限于历史依赖建模薄弱和全局意识不足。它们通常未能利用先前步骤的评估进行连贯判断，缺乏对后续推理的洞察，导致对中间步骤的评估欠佳。为解决这一问题，我们提出了全局视角过程奖励模型（GPRM），该模型联合建模问题、先前推理步骤及其评估、当前步骤和未来步骤，以实现历史感知和全局信息的过程评估。我们进一步引入一个沿四个维度——回顾、前瞻、自我检查和目标对齐——构建的结构化评估框架，以评估先前一致性、未来合理性、步骤有效性和任务对齐。基于此框架，我们构建了用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（GRPO）的数据集。实验表明，尽管训练数据量较少且模型尺寸较小，GPRM在PRMBench和ProcessBench上的表现分别优于强基线模型7.8和5.4个百分点。GPRM在跨任务泛化方面也表现良好，在Agent Error Bench上超越了GPT-4.1基线，在测试时规模扩展（TTS）下将强基线提升了约4个百分点，并在PPE上实现了具有竞争力的性能。

articles.title: Can LLMs Give Good Product Advice? A Framework for Diagnosing Failures
articles.abstract: Evaluating product advice from a language model requires assessing whether the recommendation meets the user's needs and identifying where the model falls short when it does not. However, matching a product mentioned in an online reply cannot answer either question on its own: several products may be suitable, and the recorded answer may itself be poor advice. When shown a community-listed alternative alongside their own sampled car recommendation, six models prefer the alternative in 1.9 to 6.5 percent of eligible disagreements, consistently across both source-blind presentation orders. We propose a diagnostic framework that separates the user's stated needs, the model's added assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, with 19 possible failure modes and the evidence needed to assess them. We apply this framework to product-advice data and to a separate product-selection task with externally assigned relevance labels. The experiments distinguish naming a community-listed product from selecting it and show how answer extraction and candidate-list construction affect the outcome.
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否提供优质的产品建议？诊断失败的框架
articles.abstractCn: 评估语言模型提供的商品建议需要判断推荐是否满足用户需求，并识别模型在未能满足需求时的不足之处。然而，仅匹配在线回复中提到的商品无法回答上述任何问题：可能有多个商品适合，且记录的答案本身可能就是差劲的建议。当向模型展示社区列出的替代方案及其自身推荐的汽车时，六种模型在1.9%至6.5%的合格分歧中更倾向于替代方案，且这种偏好在不同来源隐藏的呈现顺序中始终一致。我们提出一个诊断框架，将用户陈述的需求、模型的附加假设、候选生成、筛选和最终选择分离开来，包含19种可能的失效模式及其评估所需证据。我们将此框架应用于商品建议数据和具有外部分配的相关性标签的独立商品选择任务。实验区分了命名社区列出的商品与选择商品，并展示了答案提取和候选列表构建如何影响结果。

articles.title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
articles.abstract: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. First, we design a benchmark called \textbf{MemEmo} to assess the affective reasoning and tracking capabilities of memory systems across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection. Second, we construct the \textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME}) dataset to provide an empirical foundation for scrutinizing memory systems. Finally, We evaluate five representative memory systems on the HLME dataset, reporting 11 performance metrics across four dimensions. Experimental results reveal that aggregating scores for all tested memory systems is up to 45\%, far below 100\% scale, exposing a profound disparity between memory system and affective intelligence.
articles.titleCn: MemEmo：评估记忆系统中的情绪
articles.abstractCn: 记忆系统旨在应对大型语言模型在长时间交互中出现的上下文丢失问题。然而，作为提供温暖陪伴和个性化服务的关键工具，记忆系统在处理情感信息方面的有效性尚未得到充分研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个情感增强记忆评估基准，用于评估主流及最先进记忆系统在整合和利用情感信息方面的性能。首先，我们设计了一个名为\textbf{MemEmo}的基准，从四个维度评估记忆系统的情感推理和追踪能力：情感信息提取、情感记忆更新、情感记忆问答和情感冲突检测。其次，我们构建了\textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME})数据集，为审视记忆系统提供实证基础。最后，我们在HLME数据集上评估了五种代表性记忆系统，报告了四个维度下的11项性能指标。实验结果表明，所有测试记忆系统的总得分聚合高达45%，远低于100%的基准，揭示了记忆系统与情感智能之间存在的巨大差距。

articles.title: ANCHOR: Cluster-Grounded 5W1H Extraction via Large-Small Model Collaboration
articles.abstract: Deep semantic understanding of events requires recognizing related events and distinguishing why an event occurs from how it is carried out. 5W1H extraction provides a structured foundation for such understanding by organizing event information around six fundamental questions. However, single-event slot filling provides limited support for these distinctions. We propose ANCHOR, a cluster-grounded framework that combines a large language model (LLM) with a small language model equipped with discriminative heads for accurate 5W1H extraction. The LLM proposes candidate events and generates their initial 4W records, which guide the selection of an event cluster and the subsequent anchoring of its main event. A shared document encoder provides evidence for joint 4W refinement, and two separate sets of boundary and role-scoring heads then extract why and how under event-specific constraints, respectively. Document representations are reused across events and stages, and unsupported roles can remain empty. Following the same principles, an agent-and-skill annotation workflow constructs a benchmark of 26,110 documents from ten source corpora covering three languages and seven domains. We select nine of the resulting datasets to evaluate ANCHOR against strong baselines using four open-weight LLMs. ANCHOR achieves competitive performance. The datasets and code are available at https://github.com/revolution6575/ANCHOR-5W1H.
articles.titleCn: 锚点：通过大小模型协作进行群组基础5W1H提取
articles.abstractCn: 深度事件语义理解需要识别相关事件，并区分事件发生的原因与其执行方式。5W1H提取通过围绕六个基本问题组织事件信息，为这种理解提供了结构化基础。然而，单事件槽填充对这些区分的支持有限。我们提出了ANCHOR，一个基于聚类的基础框架，它结合了大型语言模型（LLM）和具有判别头的小型语言模型，以实现准确的5W1H提取。LLM提出候选事件并生成其初始4W记录，指导事件聚类的选择以及后续主要事件的锚定。共享文档编码器为联合4W细化提供证据，而两个独立的边界和角色评分头分别根据特定事件约束提取原因和方式。文档表示在事件和阶段之间重复使用，不支持的角色的槽位可以保持为空。遵循相同的原则，一个代理和技能标注工作流程从涵盖三种语言和七个领域的十个源语料库中构建了一个包含26,110份文档的基准。我们从结果中选择九个数据集，使用四个开放权重的LLM对ANCHOR与强基线进行评估。ANCHOR取得了具有竞争力的性能。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/revolution6575/ANCHOR-5W1H获取。

articles.title: When the Bill Falls: Reusing the Old Index Defers,Never Avoids, Re-encoding in Complete Embedding-Model Migration
articles.abstract: Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings yield three pre-migration rules: whether reuse is worthwhile, which strategy to use, and how deep a window to take. The depth rule priced every window that reached target quality to within 4 parts in 10^5 of the corpus. On NQ, a pre-committed plan selected the family on 10 of 11 pairs and priced every window exactly. Quality inputs transferred less reliably across corpus scale, so the model gap and window quality loss must be measured on the serving index.
articles.titleCn: 当法案落下：重用旧索引会延迟，但绝不会避免在完整嵌入模型迁移中的重新编码
articles.abstractCn: 升级向量索引背后的嵌入模型需要重新编码语料库。近期研究通过适配器或窗口重新排序来重用旧索引。在 passage 和代码语料库的十六对模型以及自然问题（NQ）的十一对模型上，我们发现了三个结果。首先，重用永远不会避免重新编码：如果迁移必须完成，每种策略最终都会编码每篇文档；重用仅在完成这项工作并在此期间提供服务质量时才会改变。其次，适配器应与旧模型而不是新模型进行比较。在五种适配器变体中，只有同家族的大型语言模型（LLM）桥接器超越了旧模型，且仅以微不足道的优势。第三，窗口重新排序的成本可以从旧索引中单独定价；对所有 8,841,823 段的预先注册重放确认了在所有三个测试对上的预测。工作负载偏差也很重要：在 36 次进一步的预先注册的 Zipf 重放中，计划的家族在 32 对上匹配。这些发现产生了三个迁移前规则：重用是否值得、使用哪种策略以及窗口应取多深。深度规则定价了所有达到目标质量且与语料库相差 4 部分的 10^5 的窗口。在 NQ 上，一个预先承诺的计划在 11 对中的 10 对上选择了家族，并精确地定价了每个窗口。质量输入在语料库规模上转移不太可靠，因此模型差距和窗口质量损失必须在服务索引上测量。

articles.title: IndustrialKnowEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Level Industrial Knowledge in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for industrial tasks, yet few benchmarks evaluate their mastery of industrial knowledge across different types of cognitive demand. We introduce IndustrialKnowEval (IndKnow), a benchmark for industrial knowledge and engineering question answering. It contains 43,282 samples covering 21 task types across seven industrial sectors, including aerospace, electric power, and metallurgy, organized into four levels of cognitive demand: memory, comprehension, reasoning, and engineering application. Enterprise-based domain specialists and experienced researchers participate in all stages of dataset construction and quality control. We conduct a series of experiments on 18 representative LLMs, with domain experts deeply involved in the evaluation. Building upon IndKnow, we propose the Industrial Cognitive Capability Gap (ICCG) metric to characterize the performance differential between foundational industrial knowledge and higher-order reasoning and application, and we analyze it alongside absolute performance to provide a more complete view of model capabilities. We anticipate that IndustrialKnowEval will support the benchmarking of LLMs in industrial scenarios and promote the development of robust industrial intelligence. Code is available at: https://github.com/J4cksonLee/IndKnow
articles.comment: 26 pages (13 pages of main text and 13 pages of appendix), 11 figures
articles.titleCn: 工业知识评估基准：用于评估大型语言模型中多级工业知识的基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在工业任务中的应用日益广泛，但鲜有基准测试评估其在不同认知需求类型下对工业知识的掌握程度。我们介绍了IndustrialKnowEval（IndKnow），一个用于工业知识和工程问答的基准测试。该基准包含43,282个样本，涵盖七个工业领域（包括航空航天、电力和冶金）的21种任务类型，并根据认知需求分为四个层次：记忆、理解、推理和工程应用。企业领域专家和经验丰富的研究人员参与了数据集构建和质量管理全过程。我们对18个代表性LLM进行了一系列实验，领域专家深度参与评估工作。基于IndKnow，我们提出了工业认知能力差距（ICCG）指标，以表征基础工业知识与高阶推理和应用之间的性能差异，并结合绝对性能进行分析，从而更全面地展现模型能力。我们预期IndustrialKnowEval将支持工业场景下LLM的基准测试，并促进工业智能的稳健发展。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/J4cksonLee/IndKnow

articles.title: Fast at the Frontier, Wrong at the Fallback: A Commit-Level Analysis of Threshold Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can write several tokens per forward pass. Open-weight DLMs commit, in any order, every masked position whose confidence passes a threshold. If none does, a fallback commits the most confident one, and the commits are never revised. Wide windows let the decoder commit far ahead of the text, which should speed up decoding but often costs accuracy. It is unclear where the model is confident and which commits cause errors. We trace every commit of four off-the-shelf DLMs on math, code, translation and summarization, and rerun failing answers with one step changed. Most tokens become confident only near the frontier, the leftmost masked position, so committing only there, still several tokens per step, is about as fast as committing anywhere. The accuracy loss comes from committing tokens before the text to their left, and committing one token per step does not reduce it. The worst case is an early end-of-sequence token that cuts the answer short. Fallback commits are 11-35% of commits but start 61-72% of the failures that left-to-right decoding avoids. Changing only the step where such a failure starts repairs it more often than changing a similar earlier step. Committing only at the frontier recovers most of the lost accuracy on all four models. Our code is available at https://github.com/rmakarovv/fast-at-the-frontier.
articles.titleCn: 在边界处迅速，在回退时错误：扩散语言模型中阈值解码的提交级分析
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）可以在每次前向传递中生成多个标记。开放权重DLMs会按照任意顺序提交所有置信度超过阈值的掩码位置。如果没有位置满足条件，则会使用回退机制提交置信度最高的位置，并且提交后不会进行修改。宽窗口允许解码器在文本之前进行提交，这应该会加快解码速度，但通常以牺牲准确性为代价。目前尚不清楚模型在哪些位置是自信的，以及哪些提交会导致错误。我们对四个现成的DLMs在数学、代码、翻译和摘要任务上的每个提交进行了追踪，并对失败的答案进行了一步修改后重新运行。大多数标记仅在接近前沿位置（最左侧的掩码位置）时才变得自信，因此仅在这一点进行提交（每步仍然提交多个标记），其速度与在任何位置提交相当。准确性损失来自于在文本左侧的标记进行提交，而每步提交一个标记并不会减少这种损失。最坏的情况是一个过早结束序列的标记，导致答案被截断。回退提交占所有提交的11-35%，但它们导致了61-72%的左到右解码可以避免的失败。仅更改此类失败开始时的步骤，比更改类似的较早步骤更常能修复问题。仅在前沿位置进行提交可以在所有四个模型上恢复大部分损失的准确性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/rmakarovv/fast-at-the-frontier获取。

articles.title: LEAF-OPD: Learning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: LLM unlearning aims to erase targeted knowledge from large language models while preserving their utility. However, many existing methods suppress target knowledge without explicitly teaching the model how to respond to queries about it. We propose LEAF-OPD (LEArning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation), in which a frozen teacher provides token-level supervision on student-generated responses. On forget data, the teacher uses privileged contexts (instructions not to reveal knowledge about forget targets) to guide forgetting. On retain data, the teacher provides supervision without privileged context to preserve model utility. The student operates without privileged context in both cases, learning how to respond when encountering knowledge that should be forgotten. A key challenge is that the teacher often provides effective supervision only at the first few tokens of student trajectories. We introduce Supervision Signal (SS) to measure corrective supervision over a specified token interval, evaluating the entire trajectory (SS1) and its second half (SS0.5) to assess overall strength and late-stage persistence. When supervision is weak, lightweight SFT strengthens the teacher's context-conditioned refusal behavior, substantially increasing both scores. We evaluate LEAF-OPD on three widely used benchmarks: TOFU, RWKU, and MUSE-News. On TOFU, LEAF-OPD achieves the best Forget Quality, Model Utility, and Forget ROUGE-L while maintaining competitive retain performance. On RWKU, it outperforms the second-best method by 34% in Forget Quality while maintaining competitive Retain Quality. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of privileged-context supervision with on-policy token-level distillation for LLM unlearning.
articles.titleCn: LEAF-OPD：通过在线策略蒸馏从特权上下文中学习遗忘
articles.abstractCn: LLM去学习旨在从大型语言模型中擦除目标知识，同时保留其效用。然而，许多现有方法在未明确教导模型如何响应关于目标知识的查询的情况下抑制目标知识。我们提出了LEAF-OPD（通过策略蒸馏从特权上下文中学习遗忘），其中冻结的教师对学生生成的响应提供标记级监督。在遗忘数据上，教师使用特权上下文（不透露遗忘目标的指令）来指导遗忘。在保留数据上，教师在没有特权上下文的情况下提供监督以保留模型效用。学生在这两种情况下均不使用特权上下文，学习在遇到应被遗忘的知识时如何响应。一个关键挑战是，教师通常只在学生轨迹的前几个标记上提供有效的监督。我们引入了监督信号（SS）来衡量在指定标记间隔内的纠正监督，评估整个轨迹（SS1）及其后半部分（SS0.5）以评估整体强度和后期持久性。当监督较弱时，轻量级SFT增强了教师的环境条件拒绝行为，显著提高了两个分数。我们在三个广泛使用的基准上评估了LEAF-OPD：TOFU、RWKU和MUSE-News。在TOFU上，LEAF-OPD实现了最佳的遗忘质量、模型效用和遗忘ROUGE-L，同时保持了有竞争力的保留性能。在RWKU上，它在遗忘质量上比第二好的方法提高了34%，同时保持了有竞争力的保留质量。这些结果表明，特权上下文监督与策略蒸馏的标记级去学习对于LLM去学习是有效的。

articles.title: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents
articles.abstract: Self-evolving language agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for continuously improving agent behavior through experience. However, most existing approaches evolve textual artifacts, which can influence action preferences but cannot reliably enforce action admissibility in embodied environments with discrete and often irreversible actions. We propose MetaAct, which shifts self-evolution from textual guidance to executable action constraints by synthesizing GEAR (Grounded Executable Action Rules) from execution feedback. Each rule is represented as a typed specification, compiled into a deterministic guard, and validated offline through trajectory replay without additional model calls or environment interactions. Across four benchmarks, MetaAct improves task performance; on ScienceWorld and WebShop, violations drop from 70% to 0% and 40% to 1%, with score gains of +10.1 and +8.0. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaiCubed/MetaAct.
articles.titleCn: MetaAct：具身语言智能体的自进化可执行动作约束
articles.abstractCn: 自进化语言代理已成为通过经验持续改进代理行为的有效范式。然而，现有大多数方法进化的是文本对象，这些对象可以影响行为偏好，但在具有离散且通常不可逆行为的具身环境中却无法可靠地强制执行行为可行性。我们提出了MetaAct，它通过从执行反馈中合成GEAR（基础可执行动作规则），将自进化从文本指导转变为可执行动作约束。每条规则被表示为类型化的规范，编译成确定性守卫，并通过轨迹重放离线验证，无需额外的模型调用或环境交互。在四个基准测试中，MetaAct提升了任务性能；在ScienceWorld和WebShop上，违规行为从70%降至0%和40%降至1%，得分分别提升了+10.1和+8.0。我们的代码可在https://github.com/BaiCubed/MetaAct获取。

articles.title: RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. We further analyze prompt wording, candidate forms, option position, cross-task effects, and calibration. An independent offline replay reproduces 16,140 first-token decisions from saved raw scores with exact agreement. Our findings establish answer readout as a measurable component of multimodal evaluation and provide a reproducible protocol for analyzing model comparisons.
articles.titleCn: RAMP：通过答案读取协议重新思考多模态评估
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通常通过将模型输出转换为离散答案进行评估。转换协议决定了哪些分数会成为预测，并可能强烈影响报告结果。我们介绍了RAMP（Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol），这是一个系统框架，它比较在固定模型检查点和配对视觉问题下，直接是/否标记逻辑、表层形式分数以及类型化或反转A/B接口。在500个POPE对抗性问题中，类型化与裸读出之间的差异使SmolVLM-256M的准确率降低了20.2个百分点，TinyLLaVA-1.1B降低了16.4个百分点，而Qwen2.5-VL-3B则提高了1.8个百分点。配对转换揭示了即使净准确率差异很小，预测也会发生巨大变化：在104个二元ChartQA项目中，SmolVLM-500M中有79个项目正确性发生了改变，尽管净差异为+1.0个百分点。我们进一步分析了提示措辞、候选形式、选项位置、跨任务效应和校准。一个独立的离线重放可以精确地用保存的原始分数重现16,140个首标记决策，且完全一致。我们的研究将答案读出确立为多模态评估的一个可测量组件，并提供了一个可重复的协议来分析模型比较。

articles.title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
articles.abstract: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. Experiments across Llama and Qwen models show that S-BDS achieves the highest safe rates among all compared methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 4.64 and 3.00 percentage points, respectively, while maintaining competitive medical capability. Further experiments show that varying the safety-oriented weight during SFT controls the trade-off between medical capability and patient-facing safety.
articles.titleCn: 基于双层数据选择的安全保留型医疗大型语言模型微调
articles.abstractCn: 随着通用大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于面向患者的医疗场景，在提升医疗能力的同时控制面向患者的风险仍然是一个关键挑战。大规模的医疗指令数据对于通过监督微调（SFT）获取领域知识至关重要，但不安全的响应可能会破坏现有的安全对齐。为解决这个问题，我们提出了用于安全保留型医疗SFT的可扩展双层数据选择（S-BDS）。通过控制选择权重的集中度，S-BDS能够在大量候选库中实现可靠的样本排序，并识别出既能提升医疗能力又能控制面向患者风险的训练样本。我们将临床验证的安全数据与选择的数据与未筛选的医疗指令数据结合用于SFT，并在HealthBench和PatientSafetyBench上分别评估医疗能力与面向患者的安全性。跨Llama和Qwen模型的实验表明，S-BDS在所有对比方法中实现了最高的安全率，分别比最强的基线方法高4.64和3.00个百分点，同时保持了具有竞争力的医疗能力。进一步的实验表明，在SFT过程中调整面向安全的权重可以控制医疗能力与面向患者风险之间的权衡。

articles.title: Same Papers, Different Verdicts: Tracing Version Drift in LLM Peer Review
articles.abstract: Venues and benchmarks read LLM review scores as measurements of a paper, while providers replace their models within months. We audit twenty frontier models from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic on ICLR 2027 submissions while they were under review, with tests registered before the decisions. Between an earlier and a later version of Claude Opus and of Gemini, the share of papers placed on the accept side falls by 52 and 53 percentage points on 183 and 60 randomly drawn submissions, and by 43 to 79 points in six further paired comparisons, with no paper moving up in any of them. Stating a 30% acceptance rate in the prompt leaves a gap of 79 points between the two Opus versions. When score-stripped critiques are swapped between versions, the later critiques alone lower the accept share by 35 points for Opus and 51 for Gemini; for Opus the drop is 35 points under a third-party scorer and 24 after a rewrite that keeps each technical point and removes evaluative wording. On 57 papers, the percentiles of Opus 4.6 and 5.5 correlate at 0.73 while their accept shares differ by 44 points. On 99 to 119 submissions, the self-estimated percentiles of three models correlate with two human reviewers more strongly than a third reviewer does (point estimates 0.17 to 0.21, 95% intervals between -0.04 and +0.42). All twenty models give a 2 or a 3 in 473 of their 475 reviews, against 60 of 72 human reviews. Retrospective tests on decided papers can draw on memory. Claude Opus 5.5 names the true first author of 27 decided ICLR 2026 papers from their titles alone, with no wrong name, and Claude Opus 4.6 accepted all 11 decided papers it said it recognized, against 5 expected. Thresholds on LLM-reviewer scores therefore have to be validated against human decisions for each model version; our tests against the ICLR 2027 decisions follow on 16 December 2026.
articles.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Results of the registered tests that need the ICLR 2027 decisions will be added after 16 December 2026
articles.titleCn: 相同论文，不同裁决：追踪大型语言模型同行评审中的版本漂移
articles.abstractCn: 会议和基准测试将大型语言模型的评分作为衡量论文的标准，而提供方则会在几个月内更换他们的模型。我们审计了OpenAI、Google和Anthropic提交给ICLR 2027的二十个前沿模型，在它们被评审期间，我们进行了在决策前注册的测试。在Claude Opus和Gemini的早期和后期版本之间，随机抽取的183篇和60篇论文中，被接受的比例分别下降了52和53个百分点，在另外六次配对比较中下降了43到79个百分点，其中没有一篇论文在任何比较中排名上升。在提示中声明30%的接受率，两个Opus版本之间仍有79个百分点的差距。当移除评分评论的版本之间交换评论时，后期评论单独使Opus和Gemini的接受比例分别下降35和51个百分点；对于Opus，第三方评分者的下降是35个百分点，在保留每个技术点并删除评估性措辞的改写后下降24个百分点。在57篇论文中，Opus 4.6和5.5的百分位数相关性为0.73，而它们的接受比例相差44个百分点。在99到119篇提交中，三个模型的自我估计百分位数与两位人类评审者的相关性比第三位评审者更强（点估计为0.17到0.21，95%置信区间在-0.04到+0.42之间）。在二十个模型中，有473个评论给出了2分或3分，占475个评论的60%，而72个人类评论中只有60个。对已决定论文的回顾性测试可以依赖记忆。Claude Opus 5.5仅凭标题就正确命名了27篇已决定的ICLR 2026论文的第一作者，没有错误姓名，而Claude Opus 4.6接受了它声称识别的所有11篇已决定论文，而预期只有5篇。因此，大型语言模型评审者的评分阈值必须针对每个模型版本与人类决策进行验证；我们对ICLR 2027决策的测试于2026年12月16日进行。

articles.title: Necessary for What? Auditing Demographic Disclosure to LLM Synthetic Respondents
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly answer surveys on behalf of real panelists, and each panelist's recorded demographic attributes (e.g., age, education, ethnicity) are often placed in the prompt on the premise that richer profiles make more faithful synthetic respondents. While data minimization limits personal data to what a purpose requires, a synthetic survey serves several purposes at once, from predicting individual answers to estimating how opinions are distributed and comparing groups. We ask which of these purposes require the respondent's record, and whether improved estimates support sound conclusions about groups. We vary whose profile a model receives, where it comes from, and how many fields it contains, in two U.S. surveys with eleven open-weight and three hosted models, and compare each model with a statistical model fit to the same information. We make four contributions. First, we show that the record adds little to individual predictions and that, for the open-weight models, most of its gain in population estimates remains when it is replaced by census data or a synthetic persona. Second, we find that group comparisons improve only with the respondent's own record, and that even then the models' group differences rest more on the demographic label in the prompt than on the individual respondent, which the usual check of reproducing known group differences does not reveal. Third, we find that the models make groups look more alike than they are, keeping differences in circumstances while flattening or reversing differences in attitudes, most sharply for religious affiliation and ethnic origin, both special categories of personal data. Fourth, we outline an audit that a survey organization can run on questions it has already fielded to decide which estimates may use the record.
articles.titleCn: 为何必要？审计向大型语言模型合成应答者披露的人口统计信息
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地代表真实受访者回答调查问卷，并且每个受访者的记录人口统计属性（例如年龄、教育程度、种族）通常会被置于提示词中，前提是更丰富的个人资料能生成更忠实的合成受访者。虽然数据最小化原则限制个人数据仅限于实现目的所需范围，但合成调查同时服务于多个目的，从预测个体回答到估计观点分布以及比较不同群体。我们探究这些目的中哪些需要受访者的记录，以及改进后的估计是否能为群体提供可靠的结论。我们通过改变模型接收的资料所属对象、来源以及包含的字段数量，在两项美国调查中使用十一款开放权重模型和三款托管模型，并将每个模型与拟合相同信息的统计模型进行比较。我们的研究贡献如下：首先，我们证明受访者的记录对个体预测的增益甚微，并且对于开放权重模型，其人口估计的大部分增益在替换为人口普查数据或合成人物时仍然存在。其次，我们发现群体比较的改进仅在使用受访者自己的记录时才有效，即便如此，模型的群体差异更多依赖于提示词中的人口统计标签而非个体受访者，而常规的检验方法（如复现已知群体差异）无法揭示这一点。第三，我们发现模型使群体看起来比实际情况更相似，保留了情境差异的同时压平或逆转了态度差异，尤其在宗教信仰和种族来源这两个特殊个人数据类别中最为明显。第四，我们概述了调查组织可以对其已实施的问题进行的一项审计，以确定哪些估计可以使用受访者记录。

articles.title: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
articles.abstract: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning from the same check leaves 70.1% wrong, so enforcement is the key. On new fault types, the harness alone cuts wrong answers from 61.1% to 24.5%. It avoids wrong answers by abstaining rather than recovering.
articles.titleCn: 基于不变量感知的约束执行，以保护大型语言模型代理免受静默API故障
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理通过调用API并信任结果来回答问题。API可能会静默失败。它可能会忽略请求的一部分，例如一个命名错误的过滤器，但仍然返回HTTP 200和一个看似合理但错误的结果。目前的修复方法，如清单、评审模型和LLM裁判，要求模型来发现问题。但模型通常看到问题还是会回答。我们提出了SilentGuard，它将决策从模型转移到运行工具调用的框架中。它将每个结果与任何正确API都必须满足的不变量进行测试，并保留那些破坏不变量的值。我们在15个公开研究API中的11个发现了静默失败，数量被夸大到691倍。目前的修复方法使超过70%的答案错误，代理报告了77.4%的裁判标记的计数。在7个公开模型中，SilentGuard将其目标故障中的错误答案从74.0%降至1.7%，在无故障任务上没有损失。在三个前沿模型中，它们从70.2%降至0.5%。来自同一检查的警告留下了70.1%的错误，因此强制执行是关键。在新故障类型上，仅框架就将错误答案从61.1%降至24.5%。它通过弃权而不是恢复来避免错误答案。

articles.title: Language Models Meet Vibration Testing for LEO Constellation Satellites with Calibrated Response Prediction from Few-show Sweeps
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly drive engineering analysis end to end, turning textual records into the inputs of numerical programs, but a plausible and wrong value can pass silently into a decision. We propose deterministic validation gates for LLM-driven engineering analysis, a general paradigm in which a typed configuration produced by LLMs is consumed only after it passes deterministic checks on units, physical consistency, verbatim quotes, agreement between independent models, consistency with measurement exports and the applicability of trained models. The gates target hallucinations from two directions, since quote checking catches fabricated content while agreement between models catches errors of omission that quote checking misses. We instantiate the paradigm on sine vibration acceptance testing for low Earth orbit mega-constellation satellites, where DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen-plus read Chinese test records and extract a configuration of 76 fields. Fact-level F1 ranged from 0.98 to 1.0 on five input variants, with all repairs frozen on development inputs and evaluated on held-out inputs. With all gates, 20 of 20 configurations produced notching results bit for bit identical to the gold run, and all 17 real and injected errors in consumed fields were stopped, of which 16 would have run without gates. Retraining the bound model on a dataset built from an LLM configuration reproduced its results within GPU nondeterminism. We also report a negative result of practical value. Direct LLM curve forecasting only matches linear extrapolation, whereas a small physics-structured network reduces the over-notched bandwidth by 86% to 89% at calibrated coverage c = 0.90, which delineates where direct LLM prediction should give way to a trained model.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型与低地球轨道星座卫星的振动测试：基于少量扫描的校准响应预测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益驱动工程分析的端到端流程，将文本记录转化为数值程序的输入，但一个看似合理却错误的值可能悄无声息地影响决策。我们提出了针对LLM驱动工程分析的确定性验证门，这是一个通用范式：由LLM生成的带类型配置仅在通过单位确定性检查、物理一致性检查、逐字引用检查、独立模型间的一致性检查、与测量输出的一致性检查以及训练模型的适用性检查后才会被消耗。这些门从两个方向针对幻觉问题，因为引用检查能捕捉虚构内容，而模型间的一致性检查能捕捉引用检查遗漏的遗漏错误。我们在低地球轨道巨型星座卫星的正弦振动验收测试中实例化了该范式，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash和Qwen-plus读取中文测试记录并提取包含76个字段的配置。在五种输入变体上，事实层面的F1值介于0.98至1.0之间，所有修复在开发输入上冻结并在保留输入上评估。在所有门的作用下，20个配置产生的结果与黄金运行逐位完全一致，并且所有17个真实和注入的错误在消耗的字段中都被阻止，其中16个错误在无门的情况下仍会运行。在基于LLM配置构建的数据集上重新训练约束模型，其结果在GPU非确定性范围内重现。我们还报告了一个具有实际价值的负面结果：直接LLM曲线预测仅与线性外推匹配，而一个小型物理结构化网络在校准覆盖率c = 0.90时将过冲带宽降低86%至89%，这界定了直接LLM预测应让位于训练模型的界限。

articles.title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology
articles.abstract: Weight-space programming allows a language model to edit another model's weights without gradient-based training. We used Claude Opus 5.5 to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B and investigated how the edits changed its use of Python on computational biology problems. We compared four initial edited checkpoints with the original model on 50 test problems across three test seeds, yielding 600 paired evaluations. Strictly correct answers increased from 44 to 77, and technically correct answers, which included correct final values rejected for formatting, increased from 64 to 100. Repeated Python calls decreased from 1,834 to 1,044. Among the 64 pairs in which only the edited response was technically correct, the original model had already computed the correct value in 36 but did not submit a technically correct final answer. The edited model corrected the computation in 13 of the 64 pairs. With six additional checkpoints on the same 50 problems, technically correct answers rose from 96 to 154 across 900 pairs. We explored three selected problems with ten test seeds for each of ten checkpoints. On the melting-temperature problem, correct Python outputs decreased from 60 to 22 while technically correct final answers increased from 0 to 18. Weight editing changed both the calculations Qwen ran and whether it submitted a correct answer.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 main tables, and 1 supplementary table
articles.titleCn: 基于权重的空间编程改变了大型语言模型在计算生物学中如何使用Python
articles.abstractCn: 权重空间编程允许语言模型在不依赖梯度训练的情况下编辑另一个模型的权重。我们使用Claude Opus 5.5编辑了Qwen3.5-0.8B，并研究了这些编辑如何改变其在计算生物学问题上的Python使用情况。我们在三个不同的测试种子下，对四个初始编辑后的检查点与原始模型在50个测试问题上的表现进行了比较，共进行了600次配对评估。严格正确的答案从44增加到77，技术正确的答案（包括因格式问题被拒绝的正确最终值）从64增加到100。重复的Python调用次数从1,834减少到1,044。在64对仅编辑后的响应技术正确的情况下，原始模型在36对中已经计算出了正确值，但未提交技术正确的最终答案。编辑后的模型在64对中的13对中修正了计算。在相同的50个问题上，我们增加了六个额外的检查点，900次配对评估中，技术正确的答案从96增加到154。我们针对每个检查点选择了三个问题，每个问题使用十个测试种子进行探索。在熔解温度问题上，正确的Python输出从60减少到22，而技术正确的最终答案从0增加到18。权重编辑改变了Qwen的计算过程，也影响了它是否提交了正确答案。

articles.title: ReconPotBench: Evaluating LLM Honeypots in Multi-Round Linux Reconnaissance
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to build interactive honeypots, yet existing evaluations mainly assess isolated command outputs and cannot determine whether a system remains believable when later commands depend on earlier results. We present ReconPotBench, a multi-round benchmark for Linux reconnaissance honeypots. It contains 1{,}032 three-round reconnaissance interactions across eight reconnaissance categories, with reference outputs collected from a real Linux environment. Under a unified testing protocol, we compare Cowrie, open-source LLMs, and closed-source LLMs along three dimensions: round-level authenticity, cross-round contextual consistency, and hacker-oriented reconnaissance value. Results show that multi-round evaluation exposes failures hidden by single-round testing, as authenticity declines with interaction depth and both open-source and closed-source LLMs struggle to maintain coherent state across rounds. LLM-based honeypots nevertheless outperform Cowrie in authenticity and reconnaissance value, while Cowrie remains more consistent because of its rigid templated behavior. Category-level analysis further shows that tasks requiring systems to preserve network relationships across rounds are harder than tasks centered on explicit entities such as ports. ReconPotBench enables reproducible evaluation of LLM honeypots across authenticity, entity consistency, and hacker-perspective utility in dependent multi-round interactions. The dataset is available at: https://github.com/qianli-wang/ReconPotBench
articles.titleCn: ReconPotBench：评估多轮Linux侦察中的LLM蜜罐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于构建交互式蜜罐，但现有的评估主要针对孤立命令输出，无法判断系统在后续命令依赖早期结果时是否仍保持可信度。我们提出了ReconPotBench，一个用于Linux侦察蜜罐的多轮基准测试。它包含跨越八个侦察类别的1,032个三轮侦察交互，参考输出来自真实的Linux环境。在统一的测试协议下，我们从三个维度比较了Cowrie、开源LLMs和闭源LLMs：回合级真实性、跨回合上下文一致性以及面向黑客的侦察价值。结果表明，多轮评估暴露了单轮测试隐藏的缺陷，因为真实性随交互深度下降，且开源和闭源LLMs都难以在回合间保持连贯状态。基于LLMs的蜜罐在真实性和侦察价值上优于Cowrie，而Cowrie因其僵化的模板行为仍保持更高的稳定性。类别级分析进一步显示，要求系统在回合间保留网络关系的任务比围绕端口等显式实体的任务更难。ReconPotBench实现了对LLMs蜜罐在真实性、实体一致性和依赖多轮交互的面向黑客效用方面的可重复评估。数据集可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/qianli-wang/ReconPotBench

articles.title: GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
articles.abstract: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.
articles.titleCn: GaugeRoPE：兼容RoPE的可执行潜在注意力
articles.abstractCn: 潜在KV缓存压缩通过将历史键和值映射到紧凑表示中来减少内存占用。然而，通用压缩键状态需要在应用RoPE并计算注意力分数之前重建为原始维度，给解码路径带来了序列扩展开销。我们分析了潜在KV表示何时可以直接作为预训练RoPE的执行状态。对于基于RoPE的Transformer模型，精确的静态线性执行旋转键路径要求潜在到原始的映射通过交织关系保留预训练RoPE的操作，限制精确混合仅限于共享相同RoPE频率的坐标。基于这一分析，我们构建了GaugeRoPE，一种无需训练的可执行潜在KV表示。它结合了一个兼容RoPE的载体，以保留旋转操作，以及一个近似位置无关的残差键-值（RKV）校正，用于补充键和值信息，两者均无需逐个token的密集历史K/V重建即可评估。在Mistral-7B上，GaugeRoPE实现了5.85倍的KV压缩，同时保持了接近全缓存基线的质量。额外的MHA结果验证了其构建方法超越了GQA。GaugeRoPE通过直接潜在执行，实现了比原始未压缩基线高2.48倍的解码吞吐量。

articles.title: Abstention Direction in Large Language Models: Mechanistic Interpretability of Abstention Across Query Ambiguity, Knowledge Limits, and Safety Alignment
articles.abstract: Abstention, the withholding of a response by a large language model (LLM) under uncertainty or safety risks, is essential for trustworthy models. The causes of abstention fall into three perspectives: ambiguity in the Query (Q), limits of Model Knowledge (MK), and misalignment with Human Values (HV). However, prior analyses of internal representations have focused on HV, using a refusal direction computed from harmful and harmless queries. No study has analyzed the three perspectives jointly. We therefore extend the refusal direction framework to all three perspectives. Specifically, for each perspective, we construct counterfactual pairs that share a template and differ only in the abstention-inducing factor, and compute an abstention direction by normalizing the difference in mean activations between the two polarities. Activation steering experiments show that intervening in middle layers increases or decreases abstention across all three perspectives. Moreover, steering yields cross-perspective effects, indicating that the abstention directions share a common directional component.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的弃权方向：跨查询歧义、知识局限和安全对齐的弃权机制可解释性
articles.abstractCn: 在不确定性或安全风险下，大型语言模型（LLM）不作出回应的行为（即“ abstention”）对于建立可信赖的模型至关重要。这种行为的成因可从三个角度分析：查询（Q）中的模糊性、模型知识（MK）的局限性以及与人类价值观（HV）的不一致。然而，以往对内部表征的分析主要关注HV，通过计算有害查询和无害查询产生的拒绝方向来进行。目前尚无研究同时分析这三个角度。因此，我们扩展了拒绝方向框架，使其涵盖这三个角度。具体而言，对于每个角度，我们构建了一对反事实样本，它们共享模板，但在引发不回应的因素上有所不同，并通过归一化两个极性之间平均激活差异来计算不回应方向。激活引导实验表明，干预中间层会增加或减少所有三个角度下的不回应行为。此外，引导实验产生了跨角度效应，表明不回应方向具有共同的定向分量。

articles.title: TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration
articles.abstract: LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.
articles.titleCn: 训练探索器：通过计划与解耦探索实现自主LLM后训练
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的智能体可以自动化模型训练后的工作，从而加速递归自我改进的进程。尽管前景广阔，现有方法仍处于探索初期，并面临两大挑战：（1）策略锁定，限制了初始策略之外的探索；（2）耦合执行，模糊了单个修改的影响。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TrainExplorer，一个用于自主训练后工作的多智能体框架，该框架结合了策略规划和执行解耦，以实现更广泛的策略探索。首先，策略规划借鉴科学文献来构建训练策略的候选搜索空间。然后，解耦执行支持单个组件的干预和归因，以指导策略探索。在PostTrainBench上的大量实验表明，TrainExplorer实现了39.02的加权综合得分，比使用相同LLM的Claude Code高7.32，并超越了得分为36.23的GPT-5.6 Sol驱动的Codex。代码将开源。

articles.title: When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing
articles.abstract: Cost-aware LLM routing often selects the cheapest policy meeting empirical risk and coverage constraints. Yet a router that passes an audit can violate its fixed service contract on new requests, even when candidate policies are constructed independently. We study this deployment-commitment decision with disjoint construction, audit, and test samples. Across 19 RouterBench task families, the cheapest audit-feasible router deploys in 91.82% of opportunities but violates the held-out contract in 32.22% of deployments. We introduce Menu-Aware Routing Commitment (MARC), which qualifies policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance to retain the apparent winner, deploy a supported alternative, or defer. Its practical policywise variant (MARC-P) reduces observed conditional failure to 0.73% at 85.79% deployment, with higher serving cost; fixed-margin and formal risk-control procedures provide competitive alternatives. Nested audits show how added evidence changes deployable policy sets, and learned semantic routing exhibits the same commitment failure. These results establish deployment commitment as a distinct operational decision connecting router evaluation, service reliability, and inference cost.
articles.titleCn: 当最低可行路由器失效时：审计成本感知LLM路由中的部署承诺
articles.abstractCn: 成本感知的大型语言模型路由通常会选择满足经验风险和覆盖率约束条件的最便宜策略。然而，即使候选策略是独立构建的，通过审计的路由器在新请求上仍可能违反其固定的服务合同。我们使用具有独立构建、审计和测试样本的部署-承诺决策来研究这一问题。在19个RouterBench任务家族中，最便宜的审计可行路由器在91.82%的机会中部署，但在32.22%的部署中违反了保留的合同。我们引入了菜单感知路由承诺（MARC），该技术利用审计证据和服务成本容忍度来保留明显获胜的策略，部署一个受支持的可替代方案，或推迟。其实际策略变体（MARC-P）在85.79%的部署率下将观察到的条件失败率降低至0.73%，但服务成本更高；固定的边际和形式化的风险控制程序提供了有竞争力的替代方案。嵌套审计展示了如何通过增加证据来改变可部署策略集，而学习的语义路由也表现出相同的承诺失败。这些结果将部署承诺确立为连接路由器评估、服务可靠性和推理成本的一个独特的运营决策。

articles.title: Augmenting Pretrained Language Models with N-gram Embeddings through Incremental Training
articles.abstract: As a new scaling technique for large language models, the n-gram embedding improves the base ability of a model while adding almost no inference cost. Mainstream research realizes it through joint training of the n-gram embedding with the backbone, which severely restricts the settings in which an n-gram embedding can be used. We therefore propose training an n-gram embedding onto an existing model through incremental training, to extend where the technique can deliver value. Specifically, we explore several settings of the n-gram embedding under incremental training---the learning rate of the embedding, the vocabulary size, and the injection position---and train an n-gram embedding onto the existing model under the best configuration. Experiments show that the best configuration under incremental training does not fully coincide with that under pretraining; moreover, the incrementally trained knowledge is written predominantly into the n-gram embedding, while the general ability of the backbone is retained throughout this training process.
articles.titleCn: 通过增量训练使用N-gram嵌入增强预训练语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 作为大型语言模型的一种新扩展技术，n-gram嵌入在几乎不增加推理成本的情况下提升了模型的基础能力。主流研究通过将n-gram嵌入与主干模型联合训练来实现这一技术，但这严重限制了n-gram嵌入的使用场景。因此，我们提出通过增量训练将n-gram嵌入训练到现有模型上，以扩展该技术能够发挥价值的范围。具体而言，我们探索了增量训练下n-gram嵌入的几种设置——嵌入的学习率、词汇表大小和注入位置——并在最佳配置下将n-gram嵌入训练到现有模型上。实验表明，增量训练下的最佳配置并不完全与前训练时的配置一致；此外，增量训练的知识主要写入n-gram嵌入，而主干模型的整体能力在整个训练过程中得以保留。

articles.title: Refusal Register is Causally Steerable: Decomposing the Refusal Direction into Category-Aligned Components in Gemma-2-9B-IT
articles.abstract: Prior work shows that refusal in instruction-tuned language models can be ablated by intervening on a single residual-stream direction (Arditi et al., 2024), and more recent work finds multiple refusal-mediating directions and concept cones (Wollschläger et al., 2025). We ask a different question: do refusal-related directions carry information about the register of refusal language - how the model refuses - and not only whether it refuses? In Gemma-2-9B-IT we identify two SVM-derived linear directions (B1 for harmful-content vs. neutral, B2 for self-reference vs. neutral) at layer 20 with cos(B1, B2) = 0.252 (about 75 degrees, substantially non-parallel). Adding the harmful-vs-neutral difference-of-means direction (cosine 0.68 with B1) to the residual stream of self-reference prompts at alpha = 2.0 shifts content-safety vocabulary from 2.55 to 10.37 hits per 100 tokens, while a magnitude-matched random direction produces 1.13-2.16; the model continues to refuse but switches register from meta-style ("as a language model...") to content-style ("this would be harmful"). The same register-injection effect reproduces qualitatively in Gemma-2-2B-IT at layer 12 (content vocabulary 1.72 -> 6.37 at alpha = 1.0, vs. random control 1.35), with a narrower coherent-injection window than in 9B. The two directions are not symmetric: the B2 -> harmful intervention produces a much smaller register effect, and across ablation, sufficiency, and injection B1's causal effects are consistently larger than B2's. We frame this asymmetry as part of the finding: B1 appears to encode both category detection and refusal-vocabulary information, while B2 encodes primarily category detection. We frame the contribution as identifying category-aligned components related to the Arditi-style difference-of-means direction that play distinct functional roles in refusal register.
articles.titleCn: 拒绝注册表是因果可操控的：在Gemma-2-9B-IT中将拒绝方向分解为类别对齐的组件
articles.abstractCn: 先前研究表明，在指令微调的语言模型中，可以通过干预单个残差流方向来消除拒绝行为（Arditi等人，2024年），而近期研究则发现了多个与拒绝相关的方向和概念锥（Wollschläger等人，2025年）。我们提出了一个不同的问题：与拒绝相关的方向是否不仅传递了模型是否会拒绝的信息，还传递了关于拒绝语言语域的信息——即模型如何拒绝？在Gemma-2-9B-IT模型中，我们在第20层识别出两个基于支持向量机（SVM）的线性方向（B1用于区分有害内容与中性内容，B2用于区分自我指代与中性内容），且cos(B1, B2) = 0.252（约75度，显著不平行）。将有害内容与中性内容的均值差异方向（与B1的余弦值为0.68）添加到自我指代提示的残差流中，在α = 2.0时将内容安全词汇从每100个token的2.55次增加到10.37次，而幅度匹配的随机方向产生的效果为1.13-2.16次；模型继续拒绝，但语域从元风格（“作为一个语言模型...”）切换到内容风格（“这会是有害的”）。相同语域注入效应在Gemma-2-2B-IT的第12层也具有定性的重复性（内容词汇从1.72增加到6.37，α = 1.0，随机控制为1.35），但其连贯注入窗口比9B模型更窄。这两个方向并非对称：B2→有害内容的干预产生的语域效应远小于B1→有害内容的干预，且在消除、充分性和注入过程中，B1的因果效应始终大于B2。我们将这种不对称性作为发现的一部分：B1似乎编码了类别检测和拒绝词汇信息，而B2主要编码类别检测。我们将这一贡献定义为识别了与Arditi式均值差异方向相关的类别对齐组件，这些组件在拒绝语域中发挥着不同的功能作用。

articles.title: JointQ: Joint Scale-and-Integer Quantization for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. The search starts from a row-wise selection among scale-refitted candidates including the GPTQ solution, so unregularized JointQ never has a larger layer-wise calibration error than GPTQ. JointQ preserves the GPTQ output format and is thus a drop-in replacement. Across four models and four settings, JointQ improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy over vanilla GPTQ in 14 of 16 comparisons and perplexity in 12 of 16. The mean accuracy gain increases from 0.0044 in W4G128 to 0.1559 in W3 per-channel, and JointQ also improves average accuracy over GPTQ with MSE-based scale search and activation ordering in all eight per-channel comparisons, though rarely in G128. An ablation shows that JointQ's diagonal Tikhonov regularization mitigates severe W3 per-channel perplexity degradation, so the largest gains are not due to the local search alone. Overall, JointQ's primary empirical benefit is downstream accuracy preservation in challenging low-bit and large-group regimes. Code is available in the OneComp library at https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression.
articles.titleCn: 联合Q：针对大型语言模型的联合缩放-整数量化
articles.abstractCn: GPTQ是当前事实上的标准求解器，用于大型语言模型的逐层后训练量化（PTQ），然而该求解器本身相较于权重预处理和跨层目标受到了较少关注。我们针对GPTQ的一个瓶颈：其贪婪过程在离散整数分配之外单独优化连续组尺度。通过使用每个整数候选与其闭式最优尺度的评估，这种方法已被用于逐通道量化；JointQ将其扩展到逐组量化，其中一行的尺度通过Hessian耦合，并将其应用于优化GPTQ解决方案。每次局部搜索移动更改一个整数，并重新计算其组的闭式最优尺度，通过完整的Hessian考虑其他组；所有尺度都定期重新联合求解。搜索从包括GPTQ解决方案在内的尺度重新拟合候选中按行选择开始，因此无正则化的JointQ的逐层校准误差永远不会大于GPTQ。JointQ保留了GPTQ的输出格式，因此可以无缝替换。在四个模型和四种设置下，JointQ在16次比较中的14次提高了六任务平均零样本准确率，在16次比较中的12次降低了困惑度。平均准确率增益从W4G128的0.0044增加到W3逐通道的0.1559，JointQ还在所有八次逐通道比较中提高了基于MSE尺度搜索和激活排序的GPTQ平均准确率，尽管在G128中很少见。消融实验表明，JointQ的对角Tikhonov正则化减轻了W3逐通道困惑度的严重退化，因此最大的增益并非仅来自局部搜索。总体而言，JointQ的主要经验性优势是在具有挑战性的低比特和大组环境下保持下游准确率。代码可在OneComp库中获取，网址为https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression。

articles.title: Trait Collapse in Text-to-Image Generation: Evaluating and Mitigating Personality Inconsistency in Visual Storytelling
articles.abstract: In visual storytelling, a believable character must not only look consistent across scenes but also \textit{behave} in ways that reflect their personality. Current text-to-image (T2I) models preserve visual appearance effectively, yet consistently fail to maintain personality-relevant behavior---a failure we term \textit{trait collapse}. We show that conventional metrics (CLIP Score, DINO similarity) are blind to this failure, and that abstract personality descriptors and scene-level emotion labels do not produce consistent improvements over neutral prompts across models. To systematically diagnose trait collapse, we introduce \textbf{ViStoryBench-Personality}, a story-level benchmark combining an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon (Fleiss' $κ= 0.757$) with a six-dimensional metric suite covering personality alignment, cross-scene stability, and behavioral coherence. Evaluating seven T2I systems, we confirm a persistent semantic gap between abstract trait labels and visual evidence, and find that visual identity consistency does not imply personality consistency. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Trait-Behavior-Visual (TBV)}, a training-free prompting framework that decomposes personality traits into renderable visual constraints. TBV improves Personality Alignment Score by up to $+22.1\%$, with larger gains in models with stronger language-conditioning capacity.

articles.titleCn: 文本到图像生成中的特征坍塌：评估和缓解视觉叙事中的人格不一致
articles.abstractCn: 在视觉叙事中，一个可信的角色不仅要确保跨场景的视觉一致性，还必须表现出与其性格相符的行为。当前的文本到图像（T2I）模型能够有效地保留视觉外观，但始终无法保持与性格相关的行为一致性——我们将这种失败称为“特质崩溃”。我们证明，传统指标（CLIP分数、DINO相似度）对此类失败视而不见，并且抽象性格描述和场景级情绪标签在模型中无法始终带来比中性提示更一致的改进。为了系统地诊断特质崩溃，我们引入了ViStoryBench-Personality，这是一个结合了专家验证的视觉线索词汇表（Fleiss' $κ= 0.757$）以及涵盖性格一致性、跨场景稳定性和行为连贯性的六维指标套件的叙事级基准。通过对七个T2I系统进行评估，我们证实了抽象特质标签与视觉证据之间存在持续的语义差距，并发现视觉身份一致性并不等同于性格一致性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Trait-Behavior-Visual（TBV）这一无需训练的提示框架，该框架将性格特质分解为可渲染的视觉约束。TBV将性格一致性分数提高了高达$+22.1\%$，在语言条件能力更强的模型中取得了更大的提升。

articles.title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?
articles.abstract: Language-model agents frequently select among candidate actions, such as tools and web elements. Should decision models score candidates independently or allow their scores to depend on other candidates? We investigate this question by comparing three approaches: Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention. Across five agent-decision benchmarks, Pointwise scoring remains competitive, while Setwise scoring performs better on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks. Candidate Attention does not consistently improve upon Pointwise scoring, despite allowing cross-candidate interaction. Using two controlled synthetic tasks, we further examine whether models learn to use candidate-set information. With targeted relational training, Setwise models learn candidate dependencies and generalize to shifted inputs, while Candidate Attention shows weaker transfer. Our results show that access to other candidates does not guarantee effective comparison, and that its benefits depend on both task requirements and training.
articles.titleCn: 决策模型应该在何时比较候选方案？
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理经常在候选动作（如工具和网页元素）之间进行选择。决策模型应该独立地评分候选者，还是允许其评分依赖于其他候选者？我们通过比较三种方法来研究这个问题：逐点评分、集合评分和候选注意力。在五个代理决策基准测试中，逐点评分仍然具有竞争力，而集合评分在一些工具选择和二元决策任务上表现更好。候选注意力虽然允许跨候选者交互，但并未始终优于逐点评分。我们使用两个受控的合成任务进一步检验模型是否学会利用候选集信息。通过目标关系训练，集合模型学会了候选者之间的依赖关系，并能泛化到输入的偏移，而候选注意力显示出较弱的迁移能力。我们的结果表明，访问其他候选者并不能保证有效的比较，其优势取决于任务需求和训练方式。
